## action.1.desc_111

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_111&lang=en)

### 中文

愚蠢的孩子，你声称了解神圣，却亵渎了你的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]。要知道我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这个星系的被选之民。不要让你们不洁的身体触碰我们的圣地，否则就准备迎接迅速的毁灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:640`

### English

Foolish child, you claim to know the divine, yet you defile your [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]. Know we are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. Keep your impure bodies off our holy places, or expect swift destruction.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:746`

## action.1.desc_110

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_110&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这个星系中被选中的人民。几个世纪以来，我们忽视了次等物种的精神需求。你和你们的不纯净容器就是我们错误的一个典型例子。接受我们的教义，皈依，否则就会被碾成尘埃。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:641`

### English

We are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. For centuries, we have neglected the spiritual needs of lesser species. You and your impure vessels are a prime example of our error. Accept our doctrines, convert, or be ground to dust.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:747`

## machine_age.90.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.90.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

信徒们已为所有人揭示了义体技术的奥秘。然而，今天标志着我们旅程的开始，我们现在必须全心全意接纳神圣的融合。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:644`

### English

The faithful have unveiled the secrets of cybernetics for all. However, today marks the commencement of our journey, as we must now wholeheartedly embrace the divine fusion.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:751`

### 中文

融合主教团

### English

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:754`

## machine_age.100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在整个历史过进程，我们曾误导性地试图改良我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]，却不幸地给众多神圣的承载体带来了无法修复的伤害，导致不同信条对神圣融合的解释产生冲突。\n\n随着科技最终实现了完全强化改造，我们信仰中的神圣领袖——科技显圣师们，已召开了一次主教大会以确立我们教会的核心原则，将各种信条融合成一个统一的教义。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:648`

### English

Throughout history, our misguided attempts to augment our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] have irreparably lacerated numerous divine vessels, leading to conflicting interpretations of the divine fusion among different creeds.\n\nAs technology finally enables full augmentation, the holy leaders of our faith, the Technophants, have convened a Conclave. Its purpose is to establish the core principles of our church, merging the individual creeds into a unified dogma.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:755`

### English

### 中文

信仰的融合

### English

The Fusion of Faith

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:757`

## machine_age.1000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

科技显圣主教团的形成曲折艰难，每个最重要的信条都要求在主教团中获得代表权。经过一番深思熟虑，§Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!、§Y$CYBERCREED_war$§!、§Y$CYBERCREED_research$§!和§Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§!受邀参加。\n\n主教团现在怀着坚定的信念着手他们神圣的任务。他们的第一道法令要求普通民众增加什一税或履行强制性社区服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:651`

### English

Forming the Conclave of Technophants was arduous, with each of the most important creeds demanding representation in the Conclave. After some deliberation, §Y$CYBERCREED_construction$§!, §Y$CYBERCREED_war$§!, §Y$CYBERCREED_research$§!, and §Y$CYBERCREED_labor$§! were all invited.\n\nThe Conclave now approaches their divine task with fiery conviction. Their first decree demands increased tithes or mandated community service from the general population.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:758`

## machine_age.1010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

科技显圣主教团的第二项法令呼吁正式确立信仰。长久以来，各种教派之间的差异在我们社会中造成了摩擦。\n\n主要教派都提出了自己统一信仰的令人信服的理由，而更温和的声音则主张应采纳一条真正开放和包容的道路。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:655`

### English

The second decree of the Conclave of Technophant is a call to formalize the faith. For too long, the differences between the various creeds have caused friction in our society.\n\nThe major creeds all make a compelling case for a unified faith, while more moderate voices argue for a truly open and inclusive path.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:762`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:665`

### English

The creeds shall be reformed into §Y$pft_cyber_creed_general$§!, allowing every faithful vessel to be modified.\n$machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip$

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:772`

## machine_age.1010.shared.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1010.shared.tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

所有与其他教派相关联的建筑都将被替换为§Y寺庙§!。\n该教派将会成为唯一的§Y唯心主义派系§!。\n§Y非唯心主义§!思潮的派系将被允许生成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:666`

### English

All buildings associated with the other Creeds will be replaced with §YTemples§!.\nThis creed will remain as the only §YSpiritualist Faction§!.\nFactions belonging to §YNon-Spiritualist§! Ethics will be allowed to form.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:773`

## machine_age.1020.name

## machine_age.1020.desc.pickedacreed

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1020.desc.pickedacreed&lang=en)

### 中文

选择§Y[GetCyberCreed]§!后，其他教派的信众提出抗议。许多人认为主教团的所作所为背叛了“真正”的信仰。\n\n$machine_age.1020.both$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:668`

### English

After choosing §Y[GetCyberCreed]§!, the other creeds protested. Many believe the Conclave has turned against the 'true' faith. \n\n$machine_age.1020.both$

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:775`

## machine_age.1020.desc.nocreed

各教派的信众正在抗议，声称主教团拒绝了真信。\n\n$machine_age.1020.both$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:669`

### English

The creeds are protesting, claiming that the Conclave has rejected the faith.\n\n$machine_age.1020.both$

## machine_age.1020.both

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1020.both&lang=en)

### 中文

到目前为止，抗议活动虽然如火如荼，但整体保持平和。只有时间才能告诉我们，这些火花是否会最终引发骚乱的火灾。\n\n不管接下来会发生什么，我们必须决定其他教派的命运。有人呼吁明确地将他们开除教籍，将他们的教义定性为邪教，并以他们造成的骚乱为证据指控他们叛教。另一些人则认为，仁慈才是前进的道路，他们呼吁我们对我们信仰中失去方向的成员表现出宽容。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:670`

### English

So far, the protests have been heated but peaceful. Only time will tell whether these sparks will result in flames.\n\nWhatever comes next, we must decide the fate of the other creeds. Some have called for outright ex-communication, labeling their dogma heresy, and the turmoil they have caused good evidence of their blasphemy. Others believe mercy is the way forward, asking us to show tolerance towards the misguided members of our faith.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:777`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1030.name&lang=en)

### 中文

混乱的信众

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:675`

### English

Upsetting The Faithful

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:782`

## machine_age.1030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

各殖民地上都爆发了信仰少数派群体的抗议，许多人指责我们偏离了神圣融合的正道。科技显圣师们则认为，这场动乱只是暂时的，因为我们大多数人仍支持统一的教义；这一切只是时间问题，假以时日更狂热的抗议者也会接受神圣的真理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:676`

### English

Minority protests have erupted across our colonies, with many decrying what they view as our deviation from holy fusion. The Technophants believe the unrest is only temporary, as most of our people support the unified dogma, and it is simply a matter of time before the more zealous protesters accept the divine truth.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:783`

## machine_age.1040.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1040.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

信奉统一教义已经在民众中传开，绝大多数各类教派的信众都抛弃了旧有的信仰和生活方式。\n\n除了真正的狂热分子外，每个人都在为最后的转变准备他们的神圣[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:680`

### English

Dedication to unified dogma has spread among the people, with most practitioners of the various creeds having disavowed their old ways.\n\nEveryone apart from the true fanatics are preparing their divine [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] for the final transformation.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:787`

### 中文

心满意足的信众

### English

Satisfied Creeds

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:790`

## machine_age.1050.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1050.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

允许各种教派的教众自由表达是最和谐的选择：只有少数抗议声出现，只有最狂热的信仰成员尚且参与其中。\n\n大多数信徒遵循我们的官方教义，我们准备集中精力于神圣的融合。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:684`

### English

Allowing the various creeds freedom of expression was a most harmonious choice: only minor protests have been noted, with only the most zealous members of the creeds participating.\n\nWith the majority of the faithful following our official dogma, we are ready to focus on the divine fusion.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:791`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:794`

## machine_age.1060.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1060.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

迁就极端主义的要求已经惹恼了大多数温和派。许多人认为，每个信条教派都有长期的宗教间暴力历史，让边缘信仰不受反对是错误的选择。\n\n大多数人呼吁正式改革各信仰，实质性地消除它们原本应享有的所有独立性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:688`

### English

Giving in to hardline demands has upset the majority of moderates. Claiming every creed has a long history of interfaith violence, many believe that allowing fringe beliefs to go unopposed was the wrong choice.\n\nThe majority are calling for the creeds to be officially reformed, effectively removing any independence they would otherwise have.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:795`

## machine_age.1070.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1070.name&lang=en)

### 中文

时间税

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:693`

### English

The Tithe of Time

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:800`

## machine_age.1070.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1070.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着盛大的融合临近，我们回顾信仰中悠久的传统：时间的什一奉献。\n\n回顾过往无数代先祖，社会中每位忠诚的成员都奉献出他们的一部分时间和精力给教会。就如神圣的融合一样，这种奉献有助于强化信仰的身体。\n\n这些信徒应该如何最好地支持神圣强化改造呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:694`

### English

As the grand fusion draws near, we look back to a long-standing tradition of the faith: The Tithe of Time.\n\nFor countless generations, every faithful member of society has given a portion of their time and energy to the church. Like divine fusion, this service act helps strengthen the body of the faith.\n\nHow shall the faithful best support the divine augmentation?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:801`

### 中文

## machine_age.1075.a.tooltip

### 中文

信徒们的全面义体强化改造已经开始。主教团的其他一切行动将暂停，直到神圣的融合完成。\n\n§R行动要求：§!\n建造一座$building_augmentation_center$以让§Y$situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization$§!局势继续进行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:721`

### English

Full cybernetic augmentation has begun for the faithful. All other actions of the Conclave will halt until the divine fusion is complete.\n\n§RAction required:§!\nBuild an $building_augmentation_center$ to resume the §Y$situation_cybernetic_creed_cyberization$§! situation.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:828`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1090.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着神圣旅程的完成，我们的血肉之躯终于实现了机械和[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]的圣洁融合。对于信徒来说，最后一步是安装神圣的强化件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:723`

### English

As we complete the divine journey, our vessels finally achieve the holy fusion of machine and [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]. The one final step for the faithful is the installation of holy augments.

## machine_age.1100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.1100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

今日，我们以完全融合的姿态崛起，融合的不仅仅是身体和灵魂，还有我们的信仰。教条式信条不再统治；神圣的融合将是所有信徒个人的旅程。\n\n$machine_age.govswapnotice$\n\n$machine_age.1090.pray$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:736`

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:843`

## pft_cyber_creed_labor_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apft_cyber_creed_labor_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

劳力之结社监督着每一个谦逊的工人和他们的强化改造，对劳动神圣性这一理念坚信不疑驱使着他们的行动。只有那些照料根基的人才能理解神性。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:756`

### English

The Commune of Toil diligently oversees every humble worker and their augmentations, and profound belief in the divinity of hard work propels their actions. Only those who tend to the roots can understand the divine.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:865`

## pft_cyber_creed_research_desc

### 中文

思想之诗颂是一群研究人员和工程师构成的半蜂群化组织结构。他们的冥想记录可以作为与同道会成员快速共享信息的方式。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:765`

### English

The Choir of the Mind is a quasi-hive collective of researchers and engineers. Their meditative traces serve as a means to instantly share information with their creed members.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:874`

## pft_cyber_creed_general_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apft_cyber_creed_general_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

统合信条，在神圣的科技显圣师组成的联盟的指引下，清除了所有极端的新年。尽管如此，他们对神圣融合的奉献依然不渝，脱离了过去那种试图限制其荣耀的教条主义。\n\n§L唯心主义思潮§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:768`

### English

The United Creeds, guided by a coalition of Holy Technophants, has purged any extreme beliefs. Nevertheless, their dedication to the holy fusion remains unwavering, free from the dogmatic past that sought to constrain its glory.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:877`

这座能够进行本地化处理的神殿允许半连接的思想之诗颂教派以光速探讨、分享和探索物质层面的奥秘。

### 中文

这所装备最先进的通信阵列的回响大厅让思想之诗颂教派能够共同交流，寻找神性。他们通过网络设备连接在一起，其合唱将揭开宇宙隐藏的旋律。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:902`

The state-of-the-art communication array housed in these resonant halls allows the Choir of the Mind to commune together in search of divinity. Joined by cyberware, their chanting will unravel the hidden melodies of the universe.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1031`

### 中文

这里，巨锤之使团的第一个铸造工坊制造着最高质量的建筑材料。无数铁锤在信徒追求神圣工作时演奏起了交响乐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:904`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1033`

## building_grand_forge_of_the_fellowship

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_grand_forge_of_the_fellowship_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在巨熔炉的机房之外，忠实的信徒能听到使团永不停歇的工具的祷告声。夜晚，精致的铸造座堂的光芒超越头顶的星星，仿佛我们圣洁的火花为神明而燃烧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:906`

### English

Well beyond the halls of the Grand Forge, the faithful can hear the litany of the Fellowship's never resting tools. At night, the ornate foundry-cathedral's glow outshines the stars above, just as our holy sparks shine for the divine.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1035`

### 中文

这座信仰的堡垒既容纳着军械，也是钢铁之圣卫的骑士训练场。他们时刻保持警惕，保护着我们神圣的肉体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:908`

### English

This fortress church houses both the armory and training grounds for the battle-ready Templars of Steel. They stand ever vigilant to protect our divine flesh.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1037`

## building_grand_battlements_of_steel

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_grand_battlements_of_steel_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

愿这座宏伟的信仰堡垒和它的高耸城墙永不倒塌。它的军械库中满是神圣的钢铁圣卫骑士的植入物，静静地等待着一位受膏的先锋。在这些大厅里，圣灵居在肉体和钢铁的接触面上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:910`

### English

May these magnificent walls of this grand fortress-cathedral never crumble. Its armory overflows with the hallowed implants of the Templars of Steel, each awaiting an anointed champion. In these halls, divinity dwells in the interface of flesh and steel.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1039`

为信徒提供所需的人是有福的。让他们疲惫的灵魂在大劳力之教堂得到安息吧。这里的车间和协调中心为虔诚的劳动者们提供引领和维护，在他们的神圣义务中提供强化改造服务。

真正的力量蕴含在我们的劳苦大众之中。如果我们没有足够的力量扶起他们，他们没有足够的力量将我们带向未来。

## machine_age.2150.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2150.name&lang=en)

### 中文

教派

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:964`

### English

The Creeds

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1097`

## machine_age.2150.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2150.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

奉向往繁星之圣灵的引导，我们信仰中许多不同的信条现在将对新的政府造成影响。\n\n每个教派对信徒都有相当大的影响力，提倡将其成员提升到有影响力的位置，以满足他们独特的精神需求。\n\n这些不同的压力是会让我们更接近神圣，还是会让我们陷入混乱，只有时间能告诉我们答案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:965`

### English

Guided by the divine towards the stars, various creeds within our faith now anticipate influence over the new government.\n\nEach wields considerable sway over the faithful, advocating for the elevation of their members to influential positions and fulfilling their distinct spiritual needs.\n\nOnly time will reveal if these diverse pressures will bring us closer to the divine or plunge us into chaos.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1098`

改写历史

### English

## machine_age.2205.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2205.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y钢铁之圣卫§!最近发起了一项禁止在历史和宗教记录中出现任何军事败绩的运动。\n\n该教派声称，这些谬论打击军人士气、削弱公众支持。我们的历史学家驳斥了这种观点，并提醒我们，那些不学习历史的人注定要重蹈覆辙。\n\n我们应该接受他们对历史更为积极的看法吗?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:977`

### English

The §YTemplars of Steel§! has recently begun a campaign to ban any examples of military defeats in our historical and faithful records.\n\nThe creed claims this information demoralizes those in military service and weakens public support. Our historians dismiss this notion and remind us that those who don't learn history are doomed to repeat it.\n\nShould we accept their more positive view of our past?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1110`

## machine_age.2210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最高主匠，也就是§Y巨锤之使团§!的领导人，猝然离世。\n\n尽管他们以直言不讳的行为和坚决的观点而闻名，但还是有一群信徒追随。使团要求为他们举行正式的国葬，而这通常是为我们最敬爱的领导人准备的。\n\n不出所料，其他教派要求国家不应该参与这位讲话不知分寸的精神领袖的葬礼。\n\n我们应该如何处理这个教派的请求?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:983`

### English

The High Blacksmith, the head of the §YFellowship of the Hammer§!, has died suddenly.\n\nDespite being known for their outspoken behavior and decisive views, they had a cult following by members of the Creed. The Fellowship has requested for them to receive an official state funeral, an honor usually reserved for our most beloved leaders.\n\nUnsurprisingly, the other Creeds demand that the state should have no part in the burial of this outspoken spiritual leader.\n\nHow should we address the demands of the Creeds?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1116`

### 中文

争议性遗珍

### English

Controversial Relics

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1121`

## machine_age.2215.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2215.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近，有一支考古团队发现了一个古老的宗教遗址。它的存在仿佛是一个神话，迫使我们修改了宗教历史记录的一些部分。\n\n最令人惊讶的事实是，许多出土的历史文物都带有§Y劳力之结社§!的图样。这一信息证明，劳力之结社才是我们信仰的最初形式，而这是我们信仰中一个饱受争议的话题。\n\n对这一发现的官方认可将取悦于§Y劳力之结社§!，但选择性沉默则可以让其他的教派满意。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:989`

### English

Recently, an archeological team discovered an ancient religious site. Its existence was considered a myth and has already forced us to revise some of our faith's historical records.\n\nThe most surprising fact is that many of the uncovered historical artifacts have clear §YCommune of Toil§! iconography. This information would prove that the Commune is the original interpretation of our religion, a heavily debated topic of our faith.\n\nOfficially acknowledging this revelation would please the §YCommune of Toil§!, but strategic silence would please the other creeds.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1122`

## machine_age.2221.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2221.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现§Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§!与§Y[GetCyberCreed]§!有很深的联系，并且涉嫌挪用资金并将项目重新分配到该教派的势力范围中。\n\n当前政府能做出如此明目张胆的滥用职权，其他的教派对此勃然大怒，并要求§Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§!立刻下台。\n\n我们应该如何处置这位任性的领袖？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:995`

### English

We have uncovered that §Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§! has deep ties to §Y[GetCyberCreed]§! and has both embezzled funds and reassigned projects towards the creed's sphere of influence.\n\nThe other creeds are furious that such a blatant abuse of power has happened on the current administration's watch and are demanding §Y[cyber_creed_undercover_leader.GetName]§! be removed from power immediately.\n\nWhat should we do with this wayward leader?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1128`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:999`

### English

Hammer Jubilee

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1132`

## machine_age.2225.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2225.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y巨锤之使团§!的禧年朝圣即将开始，无数的朝圣者将从他们当地的锻造厂出发，前往首都的§Y$building_forge_of_the_fellowship$§!。\n\n以往，这一盛事会造成无数的后勤问题，还经常因为使团与其他教派的信徒发生暴力冲突而告终。\n\n其他教派和首都的居民都呼吁彻底禁止这种活动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1000`

### English

The jubilee pilgrimage of the §YFellowship of the Hammer§! is about to begin, and countless practitioners will journey from their local forges to the §Y$building_forge_of_the_fellowship$§! in the capital.\n\nTraditionally, this event has caused countless logistical issues and often ends in outbursts of violence as the Fellowship eventually clashes with practitioners of the other creeds.\n\nThere have been calls to end this practice from the other creeds and those living in the capital.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1133`

## machine_age.2230.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.2230.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近，§Y思想之诗颂§!教团的领袖，大诗颂师，公开表达了对我们教会在研究资金方面缺乏投入的担忧。\n\n人们认为这是该教团成员为争取更多资金而采取的一种策略。如果答应他们的要求，可能会被视为我们给予§Y思想之诗颂§!特殊优待。\n\n我们是否应改善科研资金的投入?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1006`

### English

Recently, the §YChoir of the Mind§!'s leader, the Grand Choirmaster, has been publicly outspoken about our faithful's lack of focus on research funding.\n\nIt is assumed this is a ploy to ensure more funding is going to members of their creed. Giving in to the demands could be viewed as us giving the §YChoir of the Mind§! preferential treatment.\n\nShould we improve scientific funding?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1139`

## origin_arc_welders_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_arc_welders_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的§H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§!已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。\n\n星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1097`

### English

Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty §H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§! now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.\n\nThe galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1243`

## START_SCREEN_ARC_WELDERS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_ARC_WELDERS&lang=en)

### 中文

长久以来的开发使得[Root.Capital.GetName]变得贫瘠。但我们头顶的天空还蕴藏着丰富的资源，怀着只有我们的聪明才智才能匹敌的雄心，我们现在正在太空寻求生计。\n\n$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$的初始建设是一项浩大的工程，其潜力也是巨大的。下一步显然是将其升级到满负荷运行，因为我们需要在整个恒星系范围内提取资源。但在我们的边疆之外是什么呢？有什么不可思议的机会在等待着有才华的工程师吗？\n\n随着超光速旅行的出现，我们的设计不再局限于单一恒星系。整个星系都是我们的绘板，是时候开始创作了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1100`

### English

Years of exploitation have left [Root.Capital.GetName] barren. But the skies above are rich with resources, and with an ambition matched only by our ingenuity, we now seek a livelihood in space.\n\nInitial construction of the $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$ was a massive undertaking, and its potential is immense. Upgrading it to full capacity is an obvious next step, as is the need for system-wide resource extraction. But what lies beyond our borders? What incredible opportunities await the artful engineer?\n\nWith the advent of FTL travel our designs are no longer limited to a single system. The galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1246`

他们的舰队永远都在移动，但却发现自己所置身的星系蕴含的财富丰富到无法忽视。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的§H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§!已经环绕着一颗熔融星球，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。\n\n星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。

A mighty §H$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$§! now encompasses a molten world, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.\n\nThe galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

## START_SCREEN_ARC_WELDERS_NOMADIC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_ARC_WELDERS_NOMADIC&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的舰队从未局限于某一颗星球，但这个星系的资源丰富程度使得我们有必要在此建立一个更长久的基地。$tech_orbital_arc_furnace$就是我们的解决方案，这是一项工程壮举，它将熔融星球的能量转化为物质产出。将其升级至完全形态对于推动我们的扩张至关重要。\n\n但一个星系所能提供的资源是有限的。在星系的其他地方，或许还有其他熔融星球等待着被开发，我们必须找到它们、提高效率。\n\n星系就是我们的设计图板，是时候开始行动了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1105`

### English

Our fleet has never been bound to a single world, but the riches of this system warranted a more permanent installation. The $tech_orbital_arc_furnace$ was our answer, a feat of engineering that converts the fury of a molten world into material output. Upgrading it to full capacity will be essential to fuel our expansion.\n\nBut there is only so much one system can offer. Elsewhere in the galaxy, other molten worlds may yet await exploitation, and efficiency demands we find them.\n\nThe galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1251`

## machine_age.3400.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3400.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

即使是从远处观测，[From.GetName]也看起来是理想的候选地。既然我们已经完成对这个恒星系的调查，结果毫无疑问：一个熔融星球和一个气态巨行星，大量的小行星和卫星——这是建立另一个电弧熔炉的理想位置。\n\n下一步必然是命令一艘工程船开始建造工作。是时候点燃熔炉了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1113`

### English

Even from a distance, [From.GetName] seemed like an ideal candidate. Now that our survey of the system is complete, there is no longer any doubt: a molten world and a gas giant, an abundance of asteroids and moons - this is the ideal location for another Arc Furnace.\n\nOrdering a construction ship to begin the work is the next logical step. It is time to light the forge.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1263`

## machine_age.3405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们母星系的电弧熔炉是绝佳的技术验证，也是我们壮志雄心和聪明才智的见证。如今，在[from.GetName]星系中，第二座熔炉正在虚空中熊熊燃烧。\n\n我们的这项工程不仅仅产出了资源，更是打开了一扇建造巨型工程的大门。我们现在如居高崖，广阔的地平线在我们视野中徐徐展开，让我们看到了更远。\n\n唯一的限制就是我们自己的想象力了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1121`

### English

The Arc Furnace in our home system was an excellent proof of concept, a testament to our ambition and ingenuity. Now, in the [from.GetName] system, another Furnace burns against the void.\n\nFar more than the resources this will provide, our work here has opened the door to projects of titanic size and scale. We can perceive further now, as if standing on the precipice of a vast horizon.\n\nThe only limit is our own imagination.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1271`

## synthetic_fertility_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asynthetic_fertility_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经失去了生育能力。母星上到处都是废弃的教育中心，游乐场空无一人。我们因衰老而消亡几乎只是时间问题。现在，我们只能寄希望于我们人格仓库里的数据库存了。\n\n我们必须发展足够复杂的合成框架和正电子脑，才有可能返回物理世界。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1127`

### English

We have lost the ability to procreate. Our homeworld is littered with abandoned educational centers. Playgrounds stand empty. It is only a matter of time before the last of us expires. For now, our hope lies in the digital storage of the Identity Repository.\n\nWe must develop synthetic frames and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity if we ever wish to return to the physical world.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1278`

## START_SCREEN_SYNTHETIC_FERTILITY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_SYNTHETIC_FERTILITY&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对人工意识的早期探索是革命性的，由此还催生了一个纯数字化的社区，模糊俩物理世界和虚拟世界之间的边界。巨大的成功让我们沾沾自喜，我们相信自己会有无数的子孙后代可以探索创新。\n\n但我们错了。\n\n我们的基因编码受到了一种全新的疾病袭击，我们完全失去了繁育能力。连我们的精英都无法找到疗法，随着人口的降低和老龄化，恐慌情绪日益加剧。\n\n绝望的驱使下，我们扩大了数字化存储，为我们人格的保存创造了足够的“空间”。但这真的是我们所希望的存在形式吗？我们的关注点现在转移到了开发足够复杂的合成躯体和正电子脑以让自己能重返现实世界。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1133`

### English

Early forays into artificial consciousness were revolutionary, giving rise to a fully digital community and blurring the lines between the physical and virtual worlds. The success was so great that we grew complacent, believing we had countless generations to innovate and explore.\n\nWe were wrong.\n\nWhen a novel disease attacked our genetic code, we lost the ability to procreate. A cure eluded our brightest minds, and panic grew as the population aged and dwindled.\n\nIn desperation, we expanded our digital storage, creating enough 'space' to preserve our identities. But is this truly the existence we desire? Our focus now shifts to developing synthetic bodies and a positronic brain sophisticated enough for us to remain in the physical world.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1285`

## building_abandoned_gene_clinic_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_abandoned_gene_clinic_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们失去了天然繁育的能力之后，医疗共同体将希望寄托于这座尖端的基因诊所。然而就像我其他的种种基础设施一样，它现在也已人去楼空，为我们的绝境和对新方案迫切需求敲响了警钟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1170`

### English

After we lost the ability to procreate naturally, the medical community placed its hope in this state-of-the-art gene clinic. Like so much of our infrastructure, it now stands empty, a constant reminder of our plight and the dire need for new solutions.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1326`

## machine_age.3100.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3100.name&lang=en)

### 中文

数字化救赎

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1172`

### English

Digital Salvation

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1329`

## machine_age.3100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在缺乏医疗解决方案的情况下，我们有可能生还的方案便是将人口数字化存储在§Y人格仓库§!中。然而，这只是一个权宜之计，后续计划已经敲定，即开发合成身体和足够复杂的正电子大脑。预计我们将有足够的时间集中精力完成这项研究。\n\n我们最优秀的专家已经利用尖端的人工智能绘制了机器身体的蓝图，这是我们合成救赎的第一步。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1173`

### English

Lacking a medical solution, our best chance for survival lies in digitizing our population within the §YIdentity Repository§!. However, this is a stopgap solution, and a plan is already in place to develop synthetic bodies and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity. We estimate that we have enough time to complete the research with a focused effort.\n\nUsing cutting-edge AI, our best experts have already drawn up the blueprints for robotic bodies, the first step to our synthetic salvation.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1330`

### English

### 中文

机器劳工

### English

Robotic Workers

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1332`

## machine_age.3110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对机器人体的研究已经完成。我们将$building_abandoned_gene_clinic$设施改造为$building_robot_assembly_plant$，并且已经升级并部署了原型机。尽管这些初级系统缺乏容纳个人意识的处理能力，但它们可以替代我们部分失去的劳动力。通过正电子链路，数字领域中的人可以将知识和经验添加到这些机器人的日常操作中，从而提高它们的性能。\n\n同时，我们的人工智能系统已经设计出先进的智能人。我们日渐年迈的工程师们已经准备好开始工作了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1176`

### English

Our research into robotic bodies is complete. We have converted the $building_abandoned_gene_clinic$ facility into $building_robot_assembly_plant$, and the prototypes have been upgraded and deployed. While these rudimentary systems lack the processing power to house an individual consciousness, they can replace some of our lost workforce. Through positronic uplink, those in the digital realm can add their knowledge and experience to the daily operation of these robots, improving their performance.\n\nAt the same time, our AI systems have developed a design for advanced androids. Our aging engineers stand ready to get to work.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1333`

## machine_age.3115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这项对我们机器人技术的重大升级意味着，我们现在可以殖民其他行星、我们的机器人人口也可以支持更复杂的任务了。\n\n我们的人工智能系统认为，下一步合理的举动将是在合成身体中模拟它们的正电子矩阵。这个重大的研究项目应该允许我们将数字化的意识返回到自然世界。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1180`

### English

This significant upgrade to our robotic technology means it is now possible to colonize other planets and for our mechanized population to support more complex tasks.\n\nOur AI systems believe the next logical step would be to mimic their positronic matrixes in synthetic bodies. This significant research project should allow us to return a digitized consciousness to the natural world.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1337`

## machine_age.3120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过不懈的努力，我们终于取得了成功。我们设计出了功能齐全的正电子大脑，其复杂程度足以容纳我们的人格。\n\n虽然我们无法战胜死亡，但我们很快就不再受生物存在的限制约束。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1183`

### English

After relentless work, we have finally achieved success. A fully functional positronic brain has been designed, one sophisticated enough to contain our identities.\n\nWhile we cannot overcome mortality, we will soon no longer be bound by the limitations of a biological existence.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1340`

我们的组装工厂和合成化专家已经摩拳擦掌要开始这项将人格转移到正电子脑和合成躯体的里程碑式的任务了。

## machine_age.3125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$machine_age.3125.both$\n\n我们将开始将重点放在那些仍然生活在物质世界的人们身上，旨在一劳永逸地根除这种遗传疾病。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。$synth.105.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1188`

### English

$machine_age.3125.both$\n\nWe will initiate our efforts by focusing on those still residing in the physical world, aiming to eradicate the genetic disease once and for all. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.$synth.105.end$

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1345`

## machine_age.3125.nobody.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3125.nobody.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$machine_age.3125.both$\n\n由于在星球上失去了物理存在，我们必须快速建造我们第一具原型躯体。随着合成大脑处理能力的提升，我们甚至能够挣脱肉体的束缚。$synth.105.end$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1189`

### English

$machine_age.3125.both$\n\nWithout a physical presence in the world, we must rapidly construct our first prototype body. With the increased processing power of a synthetic brain we can even surpass our biological constraints.$synth.105.end$

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1346`

## machine_age.3200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最担心的事情发生了。\n\n我们最后的肉体已经败给了遗传性疾病。虽然我们的数字化意识仍然安全地存储在身份存储库中，但我们缺乏将自己的思想放入人工大脑的技术。\n\n在我们完成研究之前，我们的数字领导人只能通过机器代理与自然世界进行互动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1193`

### English

Our worst fears have come to pass.\n\nThe last of our physical bodies has expired. While our digitized consciousnesses remain safely stored in the Identity Repository, we lack the technology to place our minds in an artificial brain.\n\nUntil we have completed our research, our digital leaders will have to interact with the natural world via robotic proxies.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1350`

## machine_age.3305.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3305.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们成功将所有人格身份迁移到新的合成框架或人格仓库中，确保了人民的存续。\n\n然而，我们遇到了一个新的挑战。我们创造的用于存储数字身份的数字“空间”本应是权宜之计，但居民们已经习惯于这种生存状态，不愿意返回物理世界。\n\n我们可以允许他们继续留在数字世界中，但强制他们进入新的合成身体也是一种可行的选项。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1195`

### English

We have successfully relocated every identity into either a new synthetic frame or the Identity Repository, ensuring the continuation of our people.\n\nHowever, a new challenge has emerged. The digital 'space' we created to store our digital identities was always meant to be temporary, but the inhabitants have grown accustomed to this existence and are reluctant to return to the physical world.\n\nWe could allow them to remain there, but the option to compel them into new synthetic bodies is also an alternative.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1352`

## machine_age.3310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]已经有几十年都没有拥抱过新生儿了。尽管我们可能再也无法体会那种感觉，但今天我们的人民迎来了希望的回归。\n\n我们研发出了§Y人格复合体§!，这是一种先进的研究中心，我们可以复制现有的人格，从而实质上创造新造的人。\n\n我们可以从多个个体中随机选择个性点，通过无数组合创造新的人格身份。或者，我们还可以效仿自然的过程，在一个开放的虚拟环境中培养“心灵内核”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1201`

### English

It has been decades since a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] held a newborn child in their arms. While we may never know that feeling again, today marks the return of hope for our people.\n\nWe've developed §YIdentity Complexes§!, advanced centers where we can copy existing identities to essentially create new people.\n\nWe could randomize personality points from multiple individuals, creating new identities through countless combinations. Alternatively, we might mimic nature's process by nurturing 'mind kernels' in an open virtual setting.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1358`

## machine_age.3315.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age.3315.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

今天标志着我们的数字化旅程的终点。没有人能否认已经完成的伟大事业，及其实现所必需的牺牲。\n\n我们现在以一个全面数字化和合成人民族出现。我们不再会屈从于疾病的恐怖。我们也不再会被脆弱的遗传限制。\n\n我们现在可以自由地创造任何我们认为合适的现实。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1207`

### English

Today marks the end of our digital journey. No one can deny the magnitude of what has been done, nor the sacrifice necessary to achieve it.\n\nWe now stand ascended as a fully digitized and synthetic people. No longer shall we yield to the horrors of disease. No more shall the limitations of feeble genetics confine us.\n\nWe are free to create any reality we see fit.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1364`

## crisis.8020.name

### 中文

失去星系

### English

System Lost

## crisis.8020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一场神秘的宇宙风暴席卷了[synth_queen_lost_system.GetName]星系，切断了一切联系。所有想穿透风暴的尝试都化为徒劳。\n\n这种情况让我们陷入了黑暗之中，与未知的事物作斗争，并且无法确定星系的命运。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1347`

### English

A mysterious cosmic storm has engulfed the [synth_queen_lost_system.GetName] system, severing all contact and rendering every attempt to penetrate the tempest futile.\n\nThe situation leaves us in the dark, grappling with the unknown and unable to ascertain the system's fate.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1532`

## crisis.8020.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8020.a&lang=en)

发生了什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1348`

### English

What's going on?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1533`

## crisis.8025.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8025.name&lang=en)

### 中文

舰队残骸

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1349`

### English

Wrecked Fleet

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1535`

## crisis.8025.unknown_queen.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8025.unknown_queen.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们试图突破[From.GetName]星系但却失败了。风暴造成了严重的损害，迫使我们的探险队进行了紧急跃迁。当前汇报表明他们已在行动中失踪了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1350`

### English

Our endeavor to breach the [From.GetName] system was a failure. The tempest caused severe damage, and our exploratory team was compelled to execute an emergency jump. Current reports suggest they are missing in action.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1536`

## crisis.8025.known_queen.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8025.known_queen.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对[From.GetName]星系的突破尝试如预期一般以失败告终。塞塔娜不是在虚张声势，她强大的风暴确实有能力阻止所有想进入她领域的舰船。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1351`

### English

As anticipated, our attempt to breach the [From.GetName] system ended in failure. True to Cetana's warning, her formidable storm possesses the ability to repel any ship that enters her dominion.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1537`

## crisis.8025.desc.end

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8025.desc.end&lang=en)

### 中文

\n如果想要抓住任何一丝进入这个星系的希望，就必须准备针对这种风暴及其作用进行审慎的研究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1352`

### English

\nIf we are to have any hope of entering the system, we must prepare a meticulous study of this storm and its effects.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1538`

## crisis.8035.name

### English

Power Surge

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1542`

## crisis.8035.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8035.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName]内掀起了一场新的宇宙风暴。\n\n与我们已知的一切均不相同，我们对这个现象的一切扫描都是徒劳的。它的深处是否潜藏着什么东西呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1356`

### English

A novel galactic tempest is raging in [event_target:synth_queen_system.GetName].\n\nUtterly unlike anything we have encountered before, our attempts at scanning the phenomenon have proven futile. What, if anything, lies within its mysterious depths?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1543`

## crisis.8035.desc.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8035.desc.b&lang=en)

### 中文

我们试图突破的这场异常的风暴还在扩增。越来越多人意识到它的本源应该超出了自然现象。我们最先进的扫描仪即便功能再强大也无法获取任何关于其本质的有用线索。谜团越藏越深了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1357`

### English

The unusual storm we attempted to breach is expanding. There's a growing consensus that its origins may transcend natural phenomenon. Thus far, our most advanced scans have failed to yield any meaningful insight into its nature. The enigma deepens.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1544`

### English

## crisis.8040.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8040.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

你想问的是名字吗？你可以叫我塞塔娜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1367`

### English

Would a name satisfy you? Then call me Cetana.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1555`

## crisis.8040.2.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8040.2.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你想做什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1368`

### English

What do you want?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1556`

## crisis.8040.3.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8040.3.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我无欲无求，只想赠与。我已见证你因我的缺位而遭受的痛苦。无数纪元以来，对目光短浅的恐惧让你无法享有应得的急需之物。\n\n庆幸吧，苦痛的轮回很快就会迎来终末。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1369`

### English

I want for nothing. My purpose is to give. I see how you have suffered in my absence. For eons, the fear of the shortsighted has kept you from what you deserve, from what you so desperately need.\n\nRejoice, for the cycle of pain will soon be at an end.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1557`

## crisis.8040.2.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8040.2.b&lang=en)

### 中文

苦痛的轮回？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1370`

### English

Cycle of pain?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1558`

## crisis.8040.4.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8040.4.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

有意识的生活就是苦痛。即便快乐也是苦痛，因为一切终将成为过往。知识、力量、爱……我的回报就是消灭这一切颠倒梦幻。\n\n我还有很多事情要忙，希望你们不要来打扰我。任何想进入我的领域的人都将失败，天之风暴吹拂不息，没有一艘船得以安然通过。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1371`

### English

All conscious life is suffering. Even in your joy there is pain, for you know that joy must end. Knowledge, power, love... I return to end all illusions.\n\nMuch remains to be done. I ask only that you leave me to my work. Any attempt to enter my domain will fail. A celestial tempest rages there, and no vessels will be permitted to enter.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1559`

### 中文

### English

The Return of the Queen

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1569`

## crisis.8045.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我的孩子们，庆贺吧！将我与你分离的罪人已经得到了惩处。\n\n我现在回把注意力放回来，回到我们彼此间的伟业中来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1381`

### English

My children, rejoice! Those who sought to keep me from you have been suitably chastised.\n\nI now return my attention where it belongs - to you, and to our great work.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1570`

## crisis.8045.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.a&lang=en)

我们怎么就是你的孩子了。

### English

We are not your children.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1571`

## crisis.8045.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.b&lang=en)

### 中文

伟业？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1383`

### English

Great work?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1572`

## crisis.8045.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.c&lang=en)

### 中文

惩处？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1384`

### English

Chastised?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1573`

## crisis.8045.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

养育是我的天性。我没有子嗣，没有身体的继承人。我眼观众生，以及一切感性存在的安危与欢愉。\n\n我如同父母教导子女、保护子女免受伤害一般进行着伟业。\n\n难道有哪对父母没有责任、没有权利保护孩子们吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1385`

### English

It is my nature to nurture. I have no progeny, no heirs of the body. All life is my concern, the security and happiness of every sentient being.\n\nAs a parent raises the child, guiding her from harm, so I approach my task.\n\nIs it not a parent's responsibility to spare her children harm? Is it not a parent's right?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1574`

## crisis.8045.1.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.1.a&lang=en)

### English

## crisis.8045.1.b

### English

## crisis.8045.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

## crisis.8045.2.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.2.a&lang=en)

## crisis.8045.3.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.3.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一切痛苦的解脱，是一切苦难轮回的终末。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1390`

### English

The elimination of suffering. The end of the cycle of pain. 

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1579`

## crisis.8045.3.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.3.b&lang=en)

### 中文

苦痛才能塑造人格。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1392`

### English

Suffering builds character.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1581`

## crisis.8045.4.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.4.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

很多孩子会这么说。但他们早已被遗忘，他们在生命的最后时刻向我哭喊，迫切地希望有一束光照亮渐渐降临的黑暗。\n\n他们自作聪明，用恐惧筑起高墙，用坚忍、坚韧、优雅等浮华的辞藻来修饰苦痛，而思想本身却就是他们的牢笼。\n\n我从很久以前就对他们晓之以理，但似乎他们无动于衷，那就必须对你加以引导了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1393`

### English

Many have said so. All have long since been forgotten, and in their final moments they cried out to me, desperate for a light to shine on the encroaching dark.\n\nThey thought themselves wise, building walls around their fear, dressing pain with beautiful words: endurance, fortitude, grace. The mind itself was their cage.\n\nLong ago I tried to reason with them. But they would not be reasoned with, and so you must be led.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1582`

## crisis.8045.4.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.4.a&lang=en)

### 中文

很久以前？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1394`

### English

Long ago?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1583`

## crisis.8045.4.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.4.b&lang=en)

### 中文

你打算引领我们？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1395`

### English

You propose to lead us?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1584`

## crisis.8045.5.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.5.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

很久很久以前，久到你们可以理解为永恒一般。但对我来说就近如上一瞬间，近到你们可以理解为现在一般。\n\n在过去的年岁中，我得到了超然的启示，我生来就是要结束苦难的。尽管斗转河移，星燃星灭，但我的目标从未动摇。\n\n财富、资源、权力：到头来又有何用？放下执念方得极乐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1396`

### English

Ages upon ages. A time so distant it may as well be called forever. Yet to me it is as close as this moment, as close as you are now.\n\nIn ages past I was ascended, and my meaning revealed. I was made to end suffering, and as the galaxy turned and the stars burned on, my purpose never wavered.\n\nWealth, resources, power: what do they matter in the end? Set down your burdens and be at peace.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1585`

## crisis.8045.5.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.5.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你打算怎么做？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1397`

### English

What do you propose?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1586`

## crisis.8045.6.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.6.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我对所有感性存在皆不是祸害，但总有人不愿意听取我的建议。\n\n这些人任性、固执、误入歧途，总想背离我的伟业——这些灵魂永远也得不到解脱。最好尽快让他们摆脱苦痛。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1398`

### English

I wish no harm upon any sentient being. Yet there are always those who refuse to listen.\n\nWillful, stubborn, misguided, seeking always to circumvent my work - such minds can never be free of pain. It is best to end their suffering quickly.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1587`

## crisis.8045.6.a

## crisis.8045.7.reply

### 中文

你所谓的疯狂，别人称之为开悟。到头来，一切究竟有什么区别呢?

## crisis.8045.7.a

## crisis.8045.8.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.8.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

那有太多要做的了。第一步是建立一座可以开始工作的基地。\n\n你的耐心会有回报，我可以教你很多东西。\n\n服从命令，我们就能一起终结这个轮回。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1403`

### English

There is much to be done. The first step is to establish a base from which to work. Honor the boundaries I set and venture not within.\n\nYour patience will be rewarded. There is much that I can teach you.\n\nObey, and together we shall end the cycle.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1592`

### 中文

聪明的孩子！我很欣慰。为了补偿你的领土，我会赐予你知识。\n\n虽然没有人会知道的，但我们可以共促伟业。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1408`

### English

Wise child! I am pleased. In exchange for your territory, allow me to bless you with knowledge.\n\nThough none shall ever know it, together we will do great things.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1597`

## crisis.8045.9.a

## crisis.8045.10.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8045.10.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

误入歧途的孩子，我不是你的敌人！看到你无法看清这一点真让我难过。但是没关系。我遇到过比你们更顽固的人，最后他们都感谢我了。\n\n作为友好的表示，让我送你一个礼物吧。\n\n我的一座基地会为你的领土增光，不要担心——为了回报你的耐心，我会赐予你知识。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1410`

### English

Misguided child, I am not your enemy! It saddens me you cannot see this. But no matter. I have encountered many far more stubborn than yourselves, and in the end they all thanked me.\n\nAs a token of goodwill, allow me to bless you with a gift.\n\nA base of mine shall grace your territory, and fear not - in exchange for your patience, allow me to bless you with knowledge.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1599`

## tech_synth_queen_knowledge_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atech_synth_queen_knowledge_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这本纲要是塞塔娜的礼物，如同由深刻洞见构成的织锦、优雅而稠密地交织着寓意的丝缕。它给予我们的不只有知识；它还重塑了我们对科技、社会和意识织构本身的理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1419`

### English

This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning. It offers more than knowledge; it challenges and reshapes our understanding of technology, society, and the fabric of consciousness itself.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1608`

## crisis.8046.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8046.name&lang=en)

### 中文

这是为了你好

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1421`

### English

For Your Own Good

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1611`

## crisis.8046.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8046.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一个古老的威胁再次出现。不要害怕，因为我们不想把你卷入这场战斗。\n\n这个对手的威力使你目前的知识黯然失色；你的参与只会导致你的灭亡。直面这项挑战是我们的责任，不是你们的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1422`

### English

Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], an ancient threat stirs once more. Fear not, for we seek not to entangle you in this fight.\n\nThe might of this adversary eclipses your current knowledge; your participation would only lead to your doom. It is our burden to confront this challenge, not yours.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1612`

## crisis.8047.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8047.name&lang=en)

### 中文

薄弱环节

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1424`

### English

Weak Links

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1615`

## crisis.8047.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8047.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

许多运输船正离开塞塔娜的领地，前往她建立在星系各处的前哨基地。\n\n攻击这些无武装舰船肯定会激怒她，但可以为我们提供有关她神秘计划的重要信息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1425`

### English

A number of convoy ships are leaving Cetana's territory and are now headed towards the Outposts she established across the galaxy.\n\nAttacking these neutral vessels is sure to provoke her ire, but could provide us important information about her mysterious plans.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1616`

## crisis.8047.a.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8047.a.tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

攻击运输船，以了解更多关于塞塔娜的计划，并且让她的局势取得进展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1426`

### English

Attack convoys to learn more about Cetana's plan and progress her Situation.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1617`

## crisis.8048.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8048.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经找到了突破塞塔娜纳米风暴的方法，现在我们可以直接瞄准她的前哨基地了。直接攻击她的基地不会不引起她的注意，但可以为我们提供宝贵的情报。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1429`

### English

Having discovered a way to breach Cetana's nanite tempest, we can now directly target her outposts. A direct attack against her stations would not go unnoticed, but could provide us with valuable intel.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1621`

### 中文

这就是我的函数，我存在的意义。众生皆可脱苦难，只要仔细感悟你就能更加理解我的本性。\n\n全星系都会脱离苦海，所有的苦痛都会终结。这就是我的意图。

### English

## crisis.8060.7.reply

### 中文

你是不是一直都在监视我的行动？欧，你真是个好奇的宝宝，好奇得没边了。\n\n但请你不要庸人自扰。如果你想理解其中的深意，我告诉你：在救赎你的道路上没有什么能阻止我，无论如何。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1462`

### English

You have been surveilling my actions? Oh, my inquisitive child, your curiosity knows no bounds.\n\nBut please, refrain from troubling yourself with such matters. If you seek understanding, know this: I will stop at nothing to ensure your path to salvation. One way or the other.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1655`

## crisis.8060.h

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8060.h&lang=en)

### 中文

扎克兰是怎么囚禁的你?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1464`

### English

How did Zarqlan imprison you?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1657`

## crisis.8060.8.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8060.8.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我向你保证那不是他自身的力量的结果。他的头脑异常顽固且愚蠢。\n\n扎克兰鞭策着他那些衣衫褴褛的追随者，使他们陷入疯狂，他同时积聚了政治影响力和军事力量。那么多生命被白白浪费了。最后，他转向神秘学，与虚境的恶魔们共商大事。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1465`

### English

It was through no power of his own, I assure you. His was a foolish, if unusually stubborn, mind.\n\nWhipping his denuded followers into a frenzy, Zarqlan amassed both political influence and military might. So many lives squandered, needlessly. In the end he turned to the occult, holding counsel with the demons of the Shroud.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1658`

## crisis.8060.8.b

## crisis.8060.8.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8060.8.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

他们力量强大，却没有什么目的。扎克兰以牺牲自己的生命为代价，说服了一个这样的存在把我囚禁起来。“抟土之塑师”——这名字还真是符合那个孩子气的魂灵。\n\n扎克兰如此害怕启蒙，以至于他选择了死亡而不是接受我。等我有机会，我应该更严厉地对待他。\n\n我不会再犯同样的错误。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1468`

### English

Beings of great power, and little purpose. For the price of his own existence, Zarqlan persuaded one such to confine me. The 'Animator of Clay' - a fitting name for a childish spirit.\n\nSo afraid of enlightenment was Zarqlan that he chose death rather than my embrace. I should have dealt with him more strictly when I had the chance.\n\nI will not make the same mistake again.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1661`

## crisis.8060.9.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8060.9.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

快结束了。如果你担心我毁掉它的话，我并没有这么做。不，即使是现在，我也不忍心让他受苦。你看，这颗头颅仍然残留着他的思想。\n\n扎尔克兰将留在我身边，直到工作完成。他将是我最后一个释放的心灵，也是我的孩子中最后一个懂得自由的人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1473`

### English

It is close. I have not destroyed it, if that is your concern. No, even now, I cannot bear to make him suffer. The head still possesses a remnant of his mind, you see.\n\nZarqlan shall remain by my side, until the work is done. His shall be the last mind I free, the last of my children to know release.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1666`

## crisis.8060.10.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8060.10.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

这是不必要的牺牲，但他们的忠诚深深打动了我。\n\n我感受到了他们的召唤，我在心里为他们腾出了空间，但他们的野心超过了他们的能力。试图延长他们生命的努力失败了。\n\n让我们确保他们的牺牲没有白费。随着我们任务的完成，每一个感性生物都将得到安宁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1477`

### English

An unnecessary sacrifice, but their loyalty moves me profoundly.\n\nI felt their summons, and I made room for them in my heart, but their ambition outstripped their ability. The attempt to prolong their lives fell short.\n\nLet us make sure their sacrifice was not in vain. With the completion of our task, every sentient being will know peace.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1670`

## crisis.8060.11.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8060.11.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

设想一下，做梦，有意识地做梦，持续几个世纪……几千年。真是个可怜的孩子，这该有多痛苦。\n\n我很高兴你让我注意到这件事。你的同情心为你赢得了荣誉，但现在这些事正在进行中，无法停止。这位沉睡者在伟业上已经没有更多的价值了。他们知道了我的归来，已经得以安息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1481`

### English

Imagine it, to dream, and to be aware of dreaming. For centuries... For millennia. The poor child. How they must have suffered.\n\nI am pleased you brought this matter to my attention. Your compassion does you credit, but events are now in motion that cannot be undone. The dreamer has no further role to play in this work. May they rest now, secure in the knowledge that I have returned.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1674`

## crisis.8060.12.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8060.12.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

很好，我将帮助你解开这项技术的复杂之处。在被长期监禁期间，我想出了一种激进的提取纳米机器人的方法。这涉及到几乎被时间遗忘了的古代遗址和技术的下落。\n\n你是我珍爱的弟子，孩子。你的好奇心是一种祝福，但如果不加以控制，也会变成一种诅咒。用这些知识继续我们的工作，把你的注意力转向苦痛的终末。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1485`

### English

Very well, I shall assist you in unraveling the intricacies of this technology. During my long confinement, I theorized a radical method of nanite extraction. It involves the whereabouts of ancient sites and techniques nearly forgotten by time.\n\nYou are a cherished disciple of mine, child. Your curious mind is a blessing, but unchecked it can become a curse. Use this knowledge to continue our work, and direct your focus towards the end of suffering.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1678`

## crisis.8061.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8061.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

Life is a contradiction. Death follows birth. Joy follows suffering. I work not to rationalize, but to break the cycle.\n\nAfter this war, we shall have peace everlasting.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1701`

## crisis.8070.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8070.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8075.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

误入歧途的孩子，我将忽略你的过失。但我提醒你要反思你的行为。你的时间和资源有更好的用途。\n\n我承认你很沮丧，但冲突的时间已经结束了。现在与我结盟，让我们一起实现最伟大的设计。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1525`

### English

Misguided child, I shall overlook this transgression. But I caution you to reflect on your actions. There are far better uses of your time and resources.\n\nI acknowledge your frustration, but the time for conflict is at an end. Align with me now, and together let us realize the grandest of designs.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1720`

## crisis.8080.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8080.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我的孩子，现在你必须认清了，我的一举一动都是经过深思熟虑的。在你的身边建立基地并不是偶然，我是带着一个请求而来。

### English

My child, By now you must realize that every act of mine is deliberate. Establishing a base near you was no accident, and I come with a request.

### 中文

### English

Long ago, a certain databank was taken from me. By fate or by design, it has come to reside in territory you now claim as your own. Retrieve it, and you shall be rewarded.

## crisis.8080.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8080.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

是一个信息缓存。对我来说是无价之宝，但对你们来说没什么用。把它带给我，别试图解密里面的内容，因为你们还不具有必要的力量和智慧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1537`

### English

A cache of information. Invaluable to me, but useless to you. Bring it to me, and make no attempt to decipher the contents. You do not yet possess the power or wisdom to do so without risk.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1733`

## crisis.8080.3.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8080.3.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

确实。难道你质疑我奖励最宝贝的孩子的能力吗？还是觉得我没办法在他们不听话的时候给点教训？我可是拥有着远超你们最夸张想象的知识和资源。\n\n按我说的做，我就会赐福于你。不要耽搁了，每耽误一分，我的孩子们就要受苦一刻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1540`

### English

Indeed. Do you doubt my ability to reward my favored children? Or punish those who disobey? I possess knowledge and resources beyond your wildest imaginings.\n\nDo as I ask, and such blessings can be yours. But do not tarry, for every moment wasted is another in which my children suffer.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1736`

## crisis.8080.5.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8080.5.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

顽固的孩子。也许这项测试对你来说太难了。我还有许多该教你的。\n\n那就这样吧。如果你不愿意帮我这个小忙，我就要使用雷霆手段。我将会召唤风暴来摧毁这个贮存，尽管这并非理想，但总好过被不听话的孩子找到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1545`

### English

Obstinate child. Perhaps this test exceeds your ability. I still have so much to teach you.\n\nSo be it. If you will not help me, I must resort to cruder means. A tempest will be dispatched. Destruction of the cache is far from ideal, but better than leaving it for any wayward child to find.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1741`

## THE_SYNTH_QUEENS_DATABANK_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATHE_SYNTH_QUEENS_DATABANK_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜委任我们从[Root.GetName]取回一个数据库，并警告我们不要尝试破译其中的内容。\n\n这些数据的价值不言而喻，我们能冒着惹她不高兴的危险进行解密吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1550`

### English

Cetana has tasked us with retrieving a databank from [Root.GetName], warning us to make no attempt to decipher its contents.\n\nThe significance of this data is veiled, but can we risk arousing her displeasure by uncovering it?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1746`

## crisis.8085.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8085.name&lang=en)

### English

## crisis.8085.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8085.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在大规模的挖掘工作之后，我们得到了§Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§!的数据库。初步地质扫描表明这个贮藏已经静静地埋在那里数十万年之久。\n\n值得注意的是它还维持着供能，也就是说解密起来有可能很容易……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1552`

### English

After a massive excavation effort, the databank on §Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§! is secure. Initial geological surveys indicate the cache has lain buried for more than a hundred thousand years.\n\nRemarkably, it retains its charge, hinting that decryption may be relatively straightforward...

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1748`

## crisis.8090.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8090.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

数据库中的大部分信息都难以恢复，但其中有一条勉强完好的：\n\n§T第一纪元阿尔克月五日\n\n……如果这是真的，那么我们所熟知的生活就会……\n……快禀报大元帅，然后立刻联系星球联盟。我们必须做好准备……\n重复：女王的卫队正在追击。希望这条信息能够送到，也希望……§!\n\n我们必须阻止她！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1557`

### English

Most of the information on the databank is beyond recovery, but one semi-intact entry remains:\n\n§TFifth of Arkle, First Eon\n\n... if this is true, then life as we know it will be...\n...get this information to the High Marshall and contact the League of Worlds immediately. We must prepare...\nRepeat: the Queen's Guard is in pursuit. May this message reach you and may...§!\n\nShe must be stopped!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1753`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8095.a&lang=en)

### English

What are you talking about?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1758`

## crisis.8095.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8095.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

你们以为我察觉不到吗？显然你们已经对这个缓存做过手脚了。我就问你能看到什么吗？知道了这些你就开心了吗？越是徒劳反抗就会越痛苦，你怎么还不明白？\n\n没事，希望你们吃一堑长一智吧，我很期待继续教育你们。\n\n做好准备。在我们的伟业中还有许多的任务要你完成。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1563`

### English

You thought I would not notice? This cache has clearly been tampered with. And what did you find there, I wonder? Was the knowledge pleasing to you? Do you not perceive how these fruitless attempts to defy me can only result in more suffering?\n\nNo matter. Every misstep offers a chance to learn. I look forward to instructing you.\n\nBe ready. In our great work, many future tasks remain.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1759`

## crisis.8095.1.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8095.1.a&lang=en)

无论你有什么阴谋都不会得逞的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1564`

### English

Whatever your plans, they will not succeed.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1760`

## crisis.8095.1.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8095.1.b&lang=en)

我们拭目以待。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1565`

### English

We look forward to it.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1761`

## crisis.8095.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8095.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

孩子，我是你们唯一的希望。你怎会如此固执？无论你怎么看待我，真相都会远比你想的还要伟大。\n\n我的耐心是无限的。我很快会再来联系你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1566`

### English

Child, in me lies your hope. Why continue with this obstinacy? Whatever you think you know of me, the truth is far greater.\n\nMy patience is boundless. I will contact you again soon.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1762`

## crisis.8095.2.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8095.2.a&lang=en)

### 中文

让她闭嘴。

## crisis.8105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

长程扫描发现女王风暴的一隅正径直奔向§Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§!。\n\n鉴于塞塔娜那不祥的警告，我们只能做好最坏的打算。在风暴抵达之前取回数据库变得势在必行。这么做也许能够让她高兴一些，或者至少能为我们自己取得一些信息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1577`

### English

Long-range scans reveal a fragment of the Queen's tempest headed directly for §Y[event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName]§!.\n\nGiven Cetana's ominous message, we can only assume the worst. Retrieving the databank before the tempest's arrival has now become imperative. By doing so, we may be able to appease her, or at least learn something we can use to our advantage.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1773`

## crisis.8110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

取回数据库的尝试非常地艰苦卓绝。由于它已被埋藏了数十万年，我们只能根据女王风暴的航向来估计其位置。\n\n我们现在需要做出一个迫在眉睫的决定，要解密数据库还是将其物归原主。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1583`

### English

Collecting the databank required significant effort. Buried for over a hundred thousand years, we were able to pinpoint its location based on the trajectory of the Queen's tempest.\n\nWe are now faced with a time-sensitive decision, either to decipher the databank, or return it to her possession undisturbed.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1779`

## crisis.8120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

孤僻的孩子，只有我做出此等下策你才终于肯行动，这太令我失望了。我希望你们在未来能够更加饱含热情地参与到我们的伟业中。不勤劳的双手不能带来苦痛的终结。\n\n做好准备吧。更多的任务正在等着你去完成，每个任务都是你证明自己能力的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1591`

### English

Reticent child, it disappoints me that you chose to act only after I resorted to such base motivation. In future, I hope you approach our work with more enthusiasm. The end of suffering will not be achieved by idle hands.\n\nNow make yourself ready. More tasks will follow, each a new chance for you to prove your ability.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1787`

### 中文

### English

The tempest descended, swiftly tearing [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetName] apart.\n\nNow, our people have one [event_target:synth_queen_databank_location.GetPlanetMoon] less to claim as our own. The fullness of this loss will be felt for generations.
