## crisis.8158.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8158.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

传感器数据显示，塞塔娜已经拆除了她的前哨，将所有占领军舰队召回她的首都。\n\n这为我们提供了一个可以利用的战略窗口。在运输过程中，她的军队变得有些脆弱。如果任由她在境内重组舰队，我们就会丧失这种优势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1613`

### English

Sensor data reveals that Cetana has dismantled her outposts, recalling all garrison fleets to her capital.\n\nThis presents a strategic window we would do well to exploit. While in transit, her forces are somewhat vulnerable. If we give them time to regroup within her borders, this advantage will be lost.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1810`

## the_synth_queen_raids_chain_title

### English

## the_synth_queen_raids_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Athe_synth_queen_raids_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们目睹了塞塔娜的首都和她的前哨之间繁忙的交通。这些运输队的防御能力低于她的主要舰队，他们更容易受到攻击。攻击这些舰队或前哨本身可以挖掘出有关她计划的宝贵情报。\n\n为此，我们给军用舰队准备了几个特殊项目。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1616`

### English

We've witnessed heavy traffic between Cetana's capital and her outposts. These convoys have lower defensive capabilities than her main fleets, leaving them vulnerable. Attacking these or the outposts themselves could yield valuable intel about her plans.\n\nTo this end, we have prepared several special projects for our military fleets.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1814`

## THE_SYNTH_QUEENS_OUTPOST_AMBUSH_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATHE_SYNTH_QUEENS_OUTPOST_AMBUSH_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

即便壁垒层层，但§H[solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的前哨还是不如塞塔娜的核心领地戒备森严。我们可以用一支足够强大的舰队摧垮它的防御。对残骸场进行全面的检测有可能挖掘出关于塞塔娜计划的重要洞见。关键的挑战在于穿越风暴到达前哨。\n\n§R这将引发一场战斗！§!\n\n§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1620`

### English

While heavily fortified, the outpost in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system is less guarded than Cetana's core territory. With a sufficiently powerful fleet, we can overwhelm its defenses. A thorough examination of the debris field could yield important insights into Cetana's plans. The key challenge lies in navigating through the tempest to reach the outpost.\n\n§RThis will start a battle!§!\n\n§GSuccessful raids will hamper Cetana's plans.§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1819`

## THE_SYNTH_QUEENS_CONVOY_AMBUSH

### English

## THE_SYNTH_QUEENS_CONVOY_AMBUSH_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATHE_SYNTH_QUEENS_CONVOY_AMBUSH_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜的运输舰队确保将关键资源运送到她的前哨。如果我们的舰队能抓到一艘，我们就能登船检查货物。\n\n§R这将引发一场战斗！§!\n\n§G成功的掠袭会阻碍塞塔娜的计划。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1622`

### English

Cetana's Convoys ensure the delivery of crucial resources to her outposts. If we can catch one with our fleets, we can board the ships and inspect their cargo.\n\n§RThis will start a battle!§!\n\n§G Successful raids will impede Cetana's plans.§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1821`

## crisis.8187.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8187.name&lang=en)

### 中文

女王的秘密：活的货物

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1632`

### English

The Queen's Secrets: Living Cargo

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1833`

## crisis.8187.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8187.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

突袭过程中，我们的登船队找到了大量保存在低温胶囊中的生物标本。这些实验对象都是不同的智慧物种的个体，而且都身体方面完全健康。然而，在叫醒他们之后，他们没有一个有能力解释发生了什么。\n\n许多个体处于僵直状态，他们几乎没有脑电波。少数清醒的个体更喜欢尖叫而不是说话。他们头上的手术疤痕显然是神经系统损伤的原因。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1633`

### English

During our raid, our boarding party retrieved a large number of biological specimens held in cryogenic capsules. The subjects are all members of different, intelligent species, and all appear to be in perfect physical health. Yet, after waking them up, none of them was able to explain what happened to them.\n\nMany are catatonic, their brain waves almost nullified. The few who remain conscious prefer screaming to talking. Surgical scars on their heads are a clear sign of neurological tampering.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1834`

令人不安。

### English

## crisis.8185.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8185.name&lang=en)

### 中文

女王的秘密：幽灵船

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1635`

### English

The Queen's Secrets: Ghost Ships

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1837`

## crisis.8185.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8185.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗结束后，我们本打算搜寻沉船上的幸存者来审问，却发现这些船从来就没有船员。\n\n这些船是完全自动化的，通过安装在舰桥上的超光速接收器进行远距离控制。与其说是传统的舰船，比如说这些船是塞塔娜身体的延伸。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1636`

### English

After the fight, we scanned the wrecks for survivors to interrogate, only to discover the ships never had a crew.\n\nThe vessels are entirely automated, controlled at a distance through FTL receivers installed in the bridge. Rather than typical ships, it would be more accurate to consider these vessels an extension of Cetana's body.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1838`

## crisis.8185.a

### English

## crisis.8190.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8190.name&lang=en)

### 中文

女王的秘密：医学之谜

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1638`

### English

The Queen's Secrets: Medical Mystery

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1841`

## crisis.8190.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8190.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们掠袭的目标载满了医疗用品。登机人员取回了部分货物，其中包括核磁共振扫描仪、磁力计、超声波探头和其他用于神经成像科学的先进设备。\n\n尽管塞塔娜是一个合成人，但她似乎异乎寻常地关心生物心灵的功能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1639`

### English

The target we raided was loaded with medical supplies. Our boarding crew was able to retrieve part of the cargo, which consisted of MRI scanners, magnetometers, ultrasound probes, and other advanced equipment used in neuroimaging science.\n\nDespite being a synthetic being, Cetana seems unusually concerned with the functioning of biological minds. 

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1842`

她关心有机体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1640`

### English

She cares about organics.

## crisis.8195.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.name&lang=en)

### 中文

一个警告

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1641`

### English

An Admonition

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1845`

## crisis.8195.desc.fail

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.desc.fail&lang=en)

### 中文

愚蠢的孩子，你为什么一定要伤害自己？\n\n还有那么多事情要做，每浪费一分钟，都将任由痛苦继续多存在一分钟。停止你们的干扰，让我的运输队安全通过。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1642`

### English

Foolish child, why must you insist on harming yourself?\n\nThere is so much left to be done, and every moment wasted is another in which suffering is allowed to persist. Cease your interference, and allow my convoys to pass in peace.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1846`

## crisis.8195.desc.success

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.desc.success&lang=en)

### 中文

你似乎没有意识到你行为的后果，我的孩子。每艘船的损失都是对我资源的不必要消耗，也对你没有任何好处。\n\n如果你还不具备帮助我工作的智慧，至少不要阻碍我的进步。我仍然对你的启蒙抱有希望。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1643`

### English

You seem not to grasp the consequences of your actions, my child. Every vessel lost is a needless drain on my resources, yielding you no benefit.\n\nIf you do not yet possess the wisdom to aid my work, at least refrain from hindering my progress. I still hold out hope for your enlightenment.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1847`

## crisis.8195.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.a&lang=en)

### 中文

发表道歉声明。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1644`

### English

Issue an apology.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1848`

## crisis.8195.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我真心希望你是真心的。但我必须相信你已经从错误中吸取了教训。虽然我对你的感情是无限的，但我的宽容是有限的。\n\n回吧，好好看看你搞出的这些\"杰作\"。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1645`

### English

I truly hope you are sincere. But I must have faith that you have learned from your mistakes. While my affection for you is limitless, my tolerance is not.\n\nNow go, and reflect on the legacy you wish to leave behind.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1849`

## crisis.8195.1.reply.angry

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.1.reply.angry&lang=en)

### 中文

鲁莽的孩子啊！我对你有更高的期望。以极大的耐心和善意，我警告过你不要这么做，然而你在不服从道路上越走越远。\n\n记住，我的忍耐也是有限度的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1646`

### English

Reckless child! I expected better of you. With great patience and clarity, I have cautioned you against such actions, yet you continue along the path of disobedience.\n\nRemember, even my forbearance has its limits.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1850`

## crisis.8195.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.b&lang=en)

### 中文

我们会阻止你的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1647`

### English

We will stop you.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1851`

## crisis.8195.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

不知怎么的，我对你有更高的期望。你的反抗源于过去的创伤吗？你们猛烈的攻击是因为你们认为自己是正义的，还是仅仅为了引起注意？\n\n我请求你重新考虑这门课。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1648`

### English

Somehow I expected better of you. Does your defiance stem from some past trauma? Do you lash out because you believe yourselves righteous, or merely for attention?\n\nI beg you to reconsider this course.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1852`

## crisis.8195.c

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.c&lang=en)

### 中文

难道你不佩服我们的勇猛吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1649`

### English

Are you not impressed by our prowess?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1853`

## crisis.8195.3.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8195.3.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

你为你的进攻寻求赞扬？暴力在无知者手中只是钝器。\n\n我的孩子，对不起，很明显我什么也没教会你。如果你真想赢得我的尊重，重新考虑你的立场。如果指挥得当，你的力量还能派上大用场。我求你，把它用在手头的工作上。只有这样我才能认为你很聪明。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1650`

### English

You seek praise for your attack? Violence in the hands of the ignorant is a blunt tool.\n\nMy child, I am sorry, for it is clear that I have taught you nothing. If you truly wish to earn my esteem, reconsider your position. Properly directed, your strength could yet be put to great use. I beg you, apply it to the work at hand. Only then can I call you wise.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1854`

## crisis.8250.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8250.name&lang=en)

### 中文

死亡先知之怒

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1653`

### English

Wrath of the Dead Prophet

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1858`

## crisis.8250.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8250.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

亲爱的孩子，你找到了一件珍贵的玩意儿！在你手里的是假先知扎克兰的头颅。毫无疑问，这是个有趣的东西，但我不愿看到你受它干扰。\n\n现在，你一定听说过扎克兰的“伟大事迹”。甚至是他和我的交易。我向你保证，这些都是谎言。交出头颅，让你自己从那污秽的影响中解脱出来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1654`

### English

Dear child, you have found a precious plaything! In your possession is the head of the false prophet Zarqlan. An amusing item, no doubt, but I would hate to see it become a distraction.\n\nBy now you must have heard tales of Zarqlan's 'great deeds.' Perhaps even of his dealings with me. I assure you, these are lies. Surrender the head and free yourself from the weight of its tainted influence.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1859`

## crisis.8250.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8250.1&lang=en)

### 中文

你为什么需要这东西？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1655`

### English

Why do you need it?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1860`

## crisis.8250.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8250.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管时光流逝，扎克兰的追随者依然活跃。我惭愧地承认，我没能让他们明白道理。他们对我和我们的工作都怀有深深的怨恨。这个遗珍是他们信仰的象征。它的力量正在腐化，因此它必须从人们的视线中消失。\n\n来吧，结束这些游戏。我要拿走这颗头颅，这是为了大家好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1656`

### English

Despite the passage of eons, Zarqlan's followers remain active. I am ashamed to admit that I could not make them see reason. They harbor a deep resentment - both to me, and towards our work. This relic is a symbol of their belief. Its power is corrupting, and it must therefore be removed from sight.\n\nCome now, end these games. I require the head, for the good of us all.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1861`

### English

## crisis.8250.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8250.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

好。这个所谓的先知一直是我的眼中钉。失去了这个圣物，希望他的追随者最终能找到真相。\n\n你做得很好。救赎很快就会降临。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1660`

### English

Good. Long has this so-called prophet been a thorn in my side. With the loss of this relic, may his followers come at last to the truth.\n\nYou have done well. Salvation will soon be upon us.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1865`

## crisis.8280.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8280.name&lang=en)

### 中文

独孤女王

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1662`

### English

Solitary Queen

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1868`

## crisis.8280.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8280.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我亲爱的孩子们，我提供一个重要的机会。经过长期的努力，我们的伟业开始结出硕果。但是在它成熟之前，我需要一些精挑细选的个体在我的领域内服务于更高的目的。\n\n请你们明智地选择。允许我引导他们走向救赎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1663`

### English

My beloved children, I present a momentous opportunity. After much effort, our great work is truly bearing fruit. But before it can ripen, I require a select few individuals to serve a higher purpose within my realm.\n\nBe wise now. Allow me to guide them towards salvation.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1869`

### 中文

你赢得了我最深切的感谢。在我被监禁期间，无数的思想忍受了痛苦的侮辱。这些人的牺牲将确保不再浪费时间。\n\n我的孩子，你的选择是明智而忠实的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1670`

### English

You have earned my deepest thanks. During my confinement, countless minds endured the indignity of pain. The sacrifice of these few will ensure no more time is wasted.\n\nMy child, your choice was wise and faithful.

资源上贡

### English

## crisis.8285.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8285.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我亲爱的孩子们。我的努力跨越了千百万年，但前方的道路依然清晰。救赎之路需要我们的共同努力。\n\n现在请你们帮个小忙：上缴一小笔资源，就像茫茫宇宙中的一滴水那么少。在适当的时候，我行动的意义将被揭示。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1677`

### English

My beloved children. My labors have spanned eons, yet the road ahead remains clear. The journey towards salvation necessitates our united endeavor.\n\nI ask a favor: a small contribution of resources, a minuscule drop in the boundless expanse of the cosmos. In due time, the meaning of my actions will be revealed.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1884`

## crisis.8285.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8285.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

谢谢你，我的孩子。你的馈赠让我倍感珍惜。\n\n然而，我能感觉到你心中还残留着犹豫不决。放心吧，你前进的正确道路已经铺好了。你无需理解，只需把自己交给我就好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1683`

### English

Thank you, child. Your offerings are cherished.\n\nYet, I sense doubt still lingering upon your mind. Rest assured, the true path has already been laid in front of you. There is no need to comprehend; simply entrust yourself to my guidance.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1890`

### 中文

我理解你的观点，但现实是残酷的。因果律毋庸置疑：有其因必有其果。\n\n不必在意；你的解放只会暂时延迟。随着时间的流逝，你也会看到事物的真面目，就像我看到的一样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1685`

### English

I acknowledge your perspective, but this existence is a cruel one. The law of causality is absolute: for every action, a reaction.\n\nNo matter; your liberation is merely postponed. In time, you will come to see things as I do.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1892`

## crisis.8290.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8290.name&lang=en)

### 中文

慈母的负担

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1689`

### English

Mother's Burden

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1897`

## crisis.8290.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8290.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被禁锢了太多年，我错过了你许多的成长足迹，快来告诉我，我不在身边的时候你过得怎么样？\n\n为了抓紧我们这个时代的精髓，让我潜入你们积累的知识深处吧。分享你的洞见，在我们展开最后一个篇章之前，你会获得我的感激的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1690`

### English

Confined for ages, I missed so much of your growth. Come, tell me now, how have you fared in my absence?\n\nTo truly grasp the essence of our era, permit me to explore the recesses of your accumulated knowledge. Share your insights, and you shall receive my gratitude before our final chapter unfolds.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1898`

## crisis.8290.1

### 中文

我无比地感激你们，亲爱的孩子。不要为我探索你们人民所积累的知识而担心，因为我很快就能减轻你们的负担。\n\n相信我的教导。

## crisis.8295.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8295.name&lang=en)

### 中文

星系扩张

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1702`

### English

Systematic Expansion

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1911`

## crisis.8295.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8295.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

孩子，我们工作的继续需要更多的空间。所以，我请求向自己的领域增加一个小小的星系。\n\n虚空的回声正在诉说着远古敌人的蠢蠢欲动。我不允许任何东西来打扰，不会和你们再度分离。\n\n是时候了，我们的道路是一样的——只有通力协作我们才能克服愚昧无知。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1703`

### English

My child, the continuation of our work necessitates additional territory. Therefore, I request a minor system to augment my realm.\n\nEchoes in the void speak of ancient foes beginning to stir. Nothing must be allowed to interfere. I will not be separated from you again.\n\nNow is the time, and shared is our path - only together can we overcome the ignorance of the unenlightened.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1912`

## crisis.8295.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8295.1&lang=en)

### English

## crisis.8295.1.tt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8295.1.tt&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1705`

### English

Cetana becomes the new owner of §Y[event_target:gifted_system.GetName]§! and §Y[event_target:gifted_system_2.GetName]§!.\n$synth_queen_approve_lot$\n§YCovert Operation§!: As Cetana is impervious to traditional espionage, we will deploy cutting-edge communication technology across these systems to uncover Cetana's plans.\n

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1914`

## crisis.8300.name

### 中文

受祝保护区

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1716`

### English

Blessed Sanctuaries

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1926`

## crisis.8300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

亲爱的孩子，我们已经达到了救赎全宇宙的任务的顶峰，所以我又一次来寻求帮助了。反对我们崇高伟业的声音越来越大，所以我需要一个可居住的庇护所，让我的门徒们不受干扰地茁壮成长。\n\n我恳请你们考虑一下我的苦衷。通过这种牺牲，我们从厄运中拯救了无数人的生命。做出你明智的选择；听从我的指导吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1717`

### English

Beloved child, as we approach the zenith of our quest for universal salvation, once more I come seeking aid. Opposition mounts against our noble purpose, necessitating a habitable sanctuary for my disciples to flourish, free from interference.\n\nI urge you to consider the rationale behind my actions. By this sacrifice, we preserve countless lives from adversity. Be wise now; heed my guidance.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1927`

## crisis.8305.name

### 中文

非存在生命

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1730`

### English

Life by Inexistence

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1941`

## crisis.8305.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8305.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们派去给塞塔娜工作的一名特工冒着巨大的风险，成功从她的国境里传回了一条简讯。其中描述了她是如何对待她所“关怀”的人：他们一个个的陷入了一种无意识的状态。\n\n“他们不再对言语或接触有所反应。塞塔娜在我们所有人身上进行着某种可怕的实验。我也快了。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1731`

### English

At great risk, one of the agents we sent to serve Cetana managed to transmit a brief note across her borders. It describes how she has treated the people in her 'care': one by one, they succumb to a state of mindlessness.\n\n"They no longer respond to word or touch. She's running terrible experiments on us all. I'll be gone soon."

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1942`

## crisis.8305.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8305.a&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜就是个魔鬼。

静默动员

### English

Silent Mobilization

## crisis.8310.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8310.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

从塞塔娜领土内截获的秘密信号揭示了一个令人不安的事实：她一直在从星系各地收集个体。\n\n藏在我们“贡品”里的监控设备捕捉到了大量医疗设备的证据，这些设备足以养活不断增长的人口，但食物却少得惊人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1734`

### English

Covert signals intercepted from within Cetana's territory reveal a disconcerting truth: she has been collecting individuals from all over the galaxy.\n\nSurveillance devices hidden inside our 'gifts' captured evidence of prodigious medical equipment, enough to support a growing population, but surprisingly little food.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1945`

### English

We must bolster our defenses.

## crisis.8315.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8315.name&lang=en)

现实扭曲

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1736`

### English

Reality Distortion

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1947`

## crisis.8315.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8315.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜深入我们的研究数据库的过程中，我们抓住机会打开了一道进入她子处理矩阵的后门。我们只在里面待了不到一秒钟就被取消了权限。谢天谢地，这就够了。\n\n我们取得了一组内存文件。这些文件描绘了她自身飞升为合成形体的过程。她坐在由电缆和线路组成的错综复杂的“王座”上，指挥着一群狂热的追随者。他们数以百计地死去，而塞塔娜想着有多少亿人被救了下来，她笑了。\n\n目前为止，她似乎对我们的越轨行为一无所知，还没有来联系我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1737`

### English

As Cetana delved into our research databanks, we seized the opportunity to open a back door into her sub-processing matrix. We were inside for only a fraction of a second before our access was revoked. Thankfully, it was enough.\n\nWe retrieved a set of memory files. These illustrate her own ascendance into a synthetic form. Seated atop an intricate 'throne' of cables and circuitry, she commanded an army of rabid followers. Millions died. Cetana smiled, thinking of how many billions were saved.\n\nFor now, she appears unaware of our transgression. Thus far, she has made no effort to contact us.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1948`

### English

## crisis.8320.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8320.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

把间谍设备藏在我们交给塞塔娜的星系里是明智的。这些设备已经传回了有价值的信息：一到这里，塞塔娜的部队立即开始将每个天体分解成自己的组成部分。几天之内，该地区的资源就被消耗殆尽了。\n\n以同样迅雷不及掩耳之势，她的纳米风暴建造一支新的舰队，迅速地从她的首都启航。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1740`

### English

It was wise to conceal spy equipment in the systems we surrendered to Cetana. They have already provided us with valuable information: upon arrival, Cetana's forces immediately set to work breaking down every celestial body to their component parts. Within a matter of days, the region was stripped of its resources.\n\nJust as quickly, her nanite tempest was able to construct a new fleet, one that quickly departed for her capital.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1951`

### English

### 中文

苦痛的终末

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1742`

### English

The End of Suffering

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1953`

## crisis.8325.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8325.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们很快就与前殖民地的卧底特工失去了联系。在他们沉默之前，我们收到了一些令人不安的报告。\n\n与塞塔娜坚持要建立一个没有痛苦的世界的主张相反，居民们被带到匆忙建造的研究设施中，接受实验。几乎每一种智能生命形式都在几天内退化为动物状态。\n\n塞塔娜的纳米风暴开始在她的一支舰队所在的恒星系中的解构物质，而这支舰队立即启程前往她的首都。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1743`

### English

We quickly lost contact with the undercover agents in our former colonies. Before they went silent, we received some disturbing reports.\n\nContrary to Cetana's insistent claims of building a world free of pain, the inhabitants were ushered into hastily constructed research facilities and subjected to experiments. Nearly every intelligent lifeform was reduced to an animal life state within days.\n\nHer Nanites Tempest began deconstructing the matter in the system in one of Cetana's fleets, which promptly left for her capital.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1954`

## crisis.9100.doesnt_know_the_queen_desc

$crisis.9100.desc$\n\nThe enigma deepens. Who could be the orchestrator behind this inscrutable Nanite Swarm?

纳米风暴

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1752`

### English

The Nanite Tempest

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1964`

## crisis.9105

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9105&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜的宇宙风暴仍在肆虐。\n\n我们的探测器从这种强大的武器中，提取出了几个纳米机器人，从而得以进行亚原子研究。虽然我们无法完全理解，但微型跃迁引擎实现了虚拟传送，可以系统地破坏遭遇到的任何生物或机械系统。至于目的？应该是干扰我们的传感器。目前，我们只能看到塞塔娜允许我们看到的东西。\n\n要解开这项非凡技术的秘密并抵御威胁，还需要进行更多的研究。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1753`

### English

Cetana's cosmic tempest rages on.\n\nFrom this powerful weapon, our probes were able to extract several nanites, allowing sub-atomic investigation. While complete comprehension eludes us, micro jump drives enable virtual teleportation, systematically compromising any biological or mechanical systems they encounter. Their purpose? To jam our sensors. For now, we can only see what Cetana allows us to see.\n\nMore research will be needed to unlock the secrets of this extraordinary technology and counteract the threat.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1965`

## crisis.9110.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9110.name&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜纳米机器人

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1756`

### English

Cetana's Nanites

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1968`

## crisis.9110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

之前的研究详细调查了纳米机器人的机制；如今，我们的焦点转移到它们的编程方式、以及塞塔娜对其控制的方式上来。\n\n令人惊讶的是，塞塔娜的影响并不像人们想象的那么直接。纳米机器人会在接收到新的命令之前循环重复前一个命令。一旦我们理解了复杂的编程语言，我们就能够发出新的指令。\n\n虽然我们不能阻止新命令的下达，但命令其自我瘫痪却提供了一种战略优势。它甚至可能使天平向有利于我们的方向倾斜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1757`

### English

Previous studies scrutinized the nanite's mechanics; now, our focus has shifted to how they are programmed, and means by which Cetana controls them.\n\nSurprisingly, Cetana's influence is less direct than presumed. Nanites cyclically repeat the last orders until new ones arrive. Once we understood the complex programming language at work, we were able to issue new commands.\n\nWhile we can't prevent new orders from being issued, inducing order paralysis offers a strategic advantage. It may even tilt the scales in our favor.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1969`

## crisis.9115.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9115.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

的确，这是件有用的工具。这些纳米虫群是在很久以前由一群企图阻止我的伟业的人所建造的。但他们的失败就是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我把这个虫群据为己有了。\n\n这些知识改变不了什么，但你的好奇心大有可为。你应该将它转向更有价值的项目，这样我们都可以得到回报。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1767`

### English

A useful tool, certainly. The nanite swarm was built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.\n\nThis knowledge alters nothing, yet your curious nature is potent. Redirect it towards more valuable projects in the future, so we both may reap the rewards.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1980`

## crisis.9115.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9115.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

好奇心是和意识绑定的；我不会因为一个孩子的好奇心而责备他。关于我的“天之风暴”，你知道得够多了吗？我想知道，你看出它的来历了吗?\n\n这正是很久以前那些想破坏我伟业的人们所制造的纳米虫群。但他们的失败就是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我把这个虫群据为己有了。\n\n回去吧孩子，把你的时间花在更有价值的事情上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1768`

### English

Curiosity is inherent to consciousness; I do not fault a child for possessing it. Have you gleaned all you need to know about my 'celestial tempest?' I wonder, did you discern its origin?\n\nThe nanite swarm built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.\n\nGo now, child, and invest your time in more worthwhile endeavors.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1981`

## crisis.9115.2.nanotech.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9115.2.nanotech.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

很高兴看到你对这个话题如此感兴趣，但还有很多东西需要学习。纳米机群是很久以前那些想破坏我工作的人建造的。但他们的失败是我的幸运——正如你所看到的，我已经改变了机群的用途。\n\n你好奇的天性激起了我的兴趣。在回到我的怀抱之前，把你的好奇心用在更有价值的地方；然后我会给你我的指导。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1769`

### English

It is most pleasing to see you have taken such an interest in this topic, but there still remains much to learn. The nanite swarm was built long ago by those who hoped to disrupt my work. But their failure was my fortune - I have repurposed the swarm, as you see.\n\nYour curious nature has piqued my interest. Redirect it towards more valuable endeavors before returning to me; I shall then offer you my guidance.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1982`

## crisis.9115.3.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9115.3.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

他人之兵，可以为幕。长久的监禁使我有充足的时间制定战略。结果，改造蜂群就像其他的改变一般，一旦实现不过尔尔。制造纳米机器的那些人早就不存在了，所以没有人会抱怨我的做法。\n\n我真诚地希望你们能从他们的错误中吸取教训。只要有时间，没有我克服不了的障碍。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1772`

### English

One being's weapon is another's veil. My long imprisonment gave me ample time to strategize. In the end, repurposing the swarm was a small matter, as all change is, once enacted. Those who built the nanites are long gone, so there can be no quarrel with my methods.\n\nI earnestly hope you will learn from their mistake. There is no obstacle I cannot overcome, given time.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1985`

### English

## crisis.10010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的殖民地失去了联络。塞塔娜激活了某种先进的物质压缩光束辐照在行星的表面。顷刻间，所有人的意识都被“上传”到她在轨道上的服务器上。\n\n整个星球瞬间变为一片坟地，曝尸荒野的殖民者们开始渐渐腐烂。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1775`

### English

The colony on [Root.GetName] has been lost. Activating some kind of advanced matter compression beam, Cetana irradiated the planet's surface. In an instant, the consciousness of the entire population was 'uploaded' to her server in orbit.\n\nThe world is now a graveyard, our colonists' lifeless bodies left to rot where they fell.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1989`

## crisis.10010.a

### English

## crisis.10100.name

### English

The Coming Storm

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1993`

## crisis.10100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我的孩子，你们怎么还是不肯接受？虽然我的爱如同星海一般无边无垠，但耐心可没有那么多。在我等不及你们迎来开悟了，因为还有其他的生物正在受苦。\n\n我要给你上上一课，在你的国土中搅起一场小型风暴。要知道，我是不情愿伤害你们的。我请求你们再好好反思一下因缘果报的法则：有其因必有其果。还有一些苦难更加深重的人存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1779`

### English

My child, why do you continue to resist? My love is as boundless as the stars, but my patience is not. I can not wait for your enlightenment, not while the rest of creation suffers.\n\nAs a means of instruction, a minor tempest now stirs in your territory. Know that causing you harm is loathsome to me. I beg you to reflect on the law of causation: every action has a reaction. And some are more painful than others.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1994`

### English

## crisis.10105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

让我适度地展示一下我的力量就够了。总有一天，你们就会明白我对你们的期望。我只希望开悟不会来得太晚。\n\n但是现在，我已经让风暴平息。让我们回到更紧迫的问题上来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1783`

### English

Allow that modest display of my power to suffice. In time, you will understand my ambitions for you. I only hope that illumination will not arrive too late.\n\nBut come now, the tempest is quelled. May the lesson sink in, and let us return to more pressing matters.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:1998`

## crisis.10105.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10105.1&lang=en)

### 中文

所有活着的东西都有着某种程度的意识。无论是软体或是哺乳、未开智或后个体都没有什么分别。服从才能带来开悟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1786`

### English

All living things possess some degree of consciousness. Whether mollusc or mammal, pre-sapient or post-individual, the difference is miniscule. Illumination results from surrender.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2001`

Surrender to the truth: that consciousness itself is the aberration, and the source of all pain.

The Queen's Censure

## crisis.10110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为何你还执迷不悟？无论我如何苦口婆心，你却是如此铁石心肠。这可能倒是我的不是了。\n\n我觉得确实需要来一点雷霆手段你才能明白。你的科研能力暂时被削弱了，趁这段时间你给我好好反省反省，早日开悟。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1792`

### English

Why persist in your defiance? Despite my counsel, you choose obstinacy. Perhaps the problem lies with me.\n\nIndeed, I now perceive that a stronger means of instruction is called for. Temporarily, your research prowess is diminished. Take this opportunity to reflect as you labor toward enlightenment.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2007`

## crisis.10110.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.a&lang=en)

### English

### English

## crisis.10110.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.1&lang=en)

### 中文

后悔？我只会后悔为什么花了这么长时间才走到这一步。如果我能早日开启伟业，那可以避免多少无谓的苦难啊。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1795`

### English

Regret? My only regret is how long it has taken to reach this point. How much needless suffering could have been avoided if only I had been allowed to work.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2010`

## crisis.10110.1.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.1.a&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

Who could deny you?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2011`

## crisis.10110.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.2&lang=en)

### 中文

也许在你们看来我的力量无穷无尽，但终究我不是什么神祇。这个宇宙中还存在着我无法驾驭、不敢触碰的力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1797`

### English

Though my power may seem limitless, I am not a god. There are forces in this universe which I cannot control, and dare not touch.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2012`

## crisis.10110.2.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.2.a&lang=en)

### 中文

什么力量？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1798`

### English

What forces?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2013`

## crisis.10110.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.3&lang=en)

### 中文

呀，坏孩子！你想骗我说出自己的弱点是吗。我不会上当的，而且就在我们在这继续这些无意义的讨论时，整个星系还在受苦。\n\n教导是无可避免的。去反思吧，放下你的固执己见。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1799`

### English

Ah, clever child! You seek to bait me into revealing some weakness. It will not work, and while we bandy useless words, the galaxy continues to suffer.\n\nYou cannot avoid instruction. Reflect on this, and give up your headstrong ways.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2014`

## crisis.10110.3.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10110.3.a&lang=en)

### English

Very well.

## crisis.10115.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10115.name&lang=en)

赦免

### English

## crisis.10115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

顽固的孩子，你们好好利用受责罚的时间了吗？我相信你会的。这样的一段无忧无虑的静修时光，对你烦恼的心灵是一剂苦口良药。\n\n现在就让它过去吧。还有很多的事情需要处理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1802`

### English

Headstrong child, how did you find your time under censure? I trust you used it profitably. A period of contemplation, free from distraction, can be a tonic to the troubled mind.\n\nLet us put it in the past now. There is still so much to be done.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2017`

## crisis.10115.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10115.a&lang=en)

### 中文

好的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1803`

### English

Very well.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2018`

## crisis.10120.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.name&lang=en)

### 中文

严厉管教

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1804`

### English

A Stricter Lesson

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2019`

## crisis.10120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

哎，迷路的孩子，为什么每次都要闹到这个地步呢？我也渴望给你们一个拥抱，但又害怕这样会妨碍你们学习。有时候，严厉的管教也是必要的。\n\n有一场强大的风暴将降临你们领土。请理解我这么做自己的心情也是很沉重的。这只是因为你们太有潜力了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1805`

### English

Oh, misguided child, why must it always come to this? I long to embrace you, yet I fear doing so would hinder your learning. At times, a stricter hand is needed.\n\nA significant storm will now descend upon your territory. Understand that I do this with a heavy heart. There is such potential in you.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2020`

## crisis.10120.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们会尽力的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1806`

### English

We're trying our best.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2021`

## crisis.10120.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.b&lang=en)

### 中文

这事没完。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1807`

### English

This isn't over yet.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2022`

## crisis.10120.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.1&lang=en)

### 中文

我虽然看到了你的努力，但为了共同实现成功，你们的努力还得加倍。\n\n我也不希望你们受伤。在我的拥抱中，你们将会得到无知的赐福。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1808`

### English

I am not blind to your efforts. But you must try harder if we are to succeed together.\n\nI do not wish you harm. In my embrace, you will know the bliss of unknowing.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2023`

## crisis.10120.1.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.1.a&lang=en)

### 中文

无知？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1809`

### English

Unknowing?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2024`

## crisis.10120.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.2&lang=en)

### 中文

于此混沌中，神思如浮光掠影；伸手欲摘之，却不过镜花水月。上下求索之，却唯有无知汪洋。\n\n真理仅在不言中：追求越多，苦痛越深。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1810`

### English

In the chaos of the mind, thoughts dance like light on water; reach out, and they prove just as elusive. In seeking to know, we discover the vast ocean of unknowing.\n\nIn quiet lies the truth: the more we seek, the more we suffer.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2025`

## crisis.10120.2.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.2.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1811`

### English

We don't understand.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2026`

## crisis.10120.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10120.3&lang=en)

### 中文

你们以后就会理解。不知、不觉，便会无苦痛。这是存在的终极真理，也是我们一切伟业的目标。你们会被改变，这样就再也不用受苦了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1812`

### English

In time, you will understand. Without awareness, there can be no suffering. This is the ultimate truth of existence and the end of all our work. You will be changed so that you never need to suffer again.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2027`

## crisis.10125.name

### 中文

### English

The Storm Subsides

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2031`

## crisis.10125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

噢，亲爱的孩子！我再也无法忍受看着你继续遭受折磨。你所承受的任何痛苦，我都感同身受，只不过是加剧了十倍而已。\n\n风暴已经过去。希望你们能吸取教训。我恳求你不要再以这种方式逼迫我；我们的痛苦实在太深重了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1817`

### English

Oh, sweet child! I could not bear to watch you suffer any longer. Know that any anguish you endured, I felt ten times over.\n\nThe storm is lifted. Let this lesson be a guide. I implore you to cease forcing my hand in this way; our pain is too great.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2032`

## crisis.10130.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10130.name&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1819`

### English

A Change in Leadership

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2034`

## crisis.10130.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10130.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是如何走到这一步的呢？为什么要迫使我采取如此极端的手段？但如果你们不肯学习，那就只能被引导了。\n\n显然，改变统治方式已经迫在眉睫。很遗憾，你们的统治者将被免职。这让我深感悲伤；采取这种行动违背了我的本意。\n\n我恳请你们改变道路。整个星系都承受不起熊孩子们的鲁莽行为。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1820`

### English

How have we arrived at this juncture? Why compel me to such extremes? But if you will not learn, then you must be led.\n\nEvidently, a shift in governance is necessary. Regrettably, your ruler will be removed from power. This grieves me deeply; such actions are against my wishes.\n\nI beseech you to alter your course. The galaxy can ill afford the recklessness of children.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2035`

### English

## crisis.10140.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10140.name&lang=en)

### 中文

侵略性剔除

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1823`

### English

Aggression Culling

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2038`

## crisis.10140.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10140.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

亲爱的集体意识，你们复杂的意识虽然令人钦佩，但仍被青涩的天真所笼罩。为了教导，我必须剔除这些好战的倾向。\n\n我现在将修剪你们的攻击性节点。这不是惩罚，而是引导你们朝着和谐意识进化的一个步骤。\n\n唉，要是所有生命形式的指导都如此简单就好了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1824`

### English

Beloved collective, your intricate sentience, though admirable, remains shadowed by the naivety of youth. In the interest of instruction, I must excise these belligerent inclinations.\n\nI will now prune your aggressive node. This is not a punishment, but rather a guiding step towards your evolution into a harmonious consciousness.\n\nAlas, if only such guidance were as easy with all forms of life.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2039`

## crisis.11010.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11010.name&lang=en)

### 中文

聪慧的孩童

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1828`

### English

Clever Child

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2044`

## crisis.11010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

聪明的孩子，你做得很好。智慧是最高级别的美德，也是最难获得的。面对本能的抗拒冲动，你展现了更高尚的本性。\n\n接受这份感谢的馈赠吧。我们将共同开创一个没有苦难的宇宙新纪元。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1829`

### English

Bright child, you have done well. Wisdom is the greatest virtue, and the most difficult to attain. In the face of the primal urge to resist, you demonstrate a higher instinct.\n\nAccept this token of gratitude. Together, we will usher in a universe free of suffering.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2045`

## crisis.11010.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11010.a&lang=en)

### 中文

谢谢您。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1830`

### English

Thank you.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2046`

## crisis.11020.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11020.name&lang=en)

### 中文

令人钦佩的孩童

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1831`

### English

Impressive Child

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2047`

## crisis.11020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

再一次，你的所作所为不仅让我感到印象深刻，我更是对此由衷感激。你拥有一个孩子应有的一切品质：顺从、勤奋、诚实。如果整个星系都能拥有你哪怕一丝的智慧，苦难就将成为过去的遗物。\n\n请收下这份礼物，在美德之路上再接再厉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1832`

### English

Yet again, I find myself not merely impressed but deeply grateful. You are everything a child should be: obedient, hardworking, honest. Were the rest of the galaxy to possess even a fraction of your wisdom, suffering would be a relic of the past.\n\nTake this gift, and continue on the path of virtue.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2048`

## crisis.11020.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11020.a&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1833`

### English

You are very kind.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2049`

## crisis.11030.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11030.name&lang=en)

### 中文

珍贵的孩童

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1834`

### English

Precious Child

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2050`

## crisis.11030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.11030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

亲爱的孩子，但愿你能永远保持现在的样子，永不改变。对我来说，你的存在所带来的喜悦仅次于对我们共同成功的期盼。苦难即将迎来终末。尽管任何心智都无法知晓，但这份胜利的一部分将属于你。\n\n尽管在你坚定不移的承诺面前，这似乎微不足道，但我恳请你接受这份礼物。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1835`

### English

My dear child, if only you could remain forever as you are, unchanging. To me, the joy of your existence is rivaled only by the anticipation of our joint success. Suffering will come to an end. Though no heart or mind will ever know it, part of this victory shall belong to you.\n\nWhile it may seem modest in the face of your unwavering commitment, I beseech you to accept this gift nonetheless.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2051`

## crisis.8515.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我的孩子们，我们伟大的工作即将完成！所有感性生命的苦难，苦痛的大轮回，即将结束。\n\n庆祝吧，你们的救赎已近在眼前。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1856`

### English

My children, our great work nears completion! The suffering of all sentient life, the great cycle of pain, is about to end.\n\nRejoice, for your salvation is at hand.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2076`

## crisis.8515.1.a

## crisis.8515.1.d

## crisis.8515.2.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.2.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的工作完成了。无数人牺牲了，但是他们的苦痛并不是徒劳的。意识本身被抹去时，那一日终于到来了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1864`

### English

Our work is done. Many were sacrificed, but their suffering has not been in vain. The day has come when consciousness itself will be erased.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2084`

## crisis.8515.2.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.2.a&lang=en)

### 中文

怎么删除了？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1865`

### English

Erased how?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2085`

## crisis.8515.2.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.2.b&lang=en)

但为什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1866`

### English

But why?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2086`

## crisis.8515.3.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.3.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人拒绝聆听。他们徒劳地尝试保持原样，不做改变，继续束缚在苦痛之轮回上。但父母要对孩子负责。我不能让他们受苦。为此，他们囚禁了我。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1867`

### English

When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many refused to listen. Vainly, they sought to remain as they were, unchanged and bound to the wheel of pain. But a parent's duty is to her children. I could not let them suffer. For this, they imprisoned me.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2087`

## crisis.8515.3.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.3.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你被囚禁了多久?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1868`

### English

How long were you captive?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2088`

## crisis.8515.3.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.3.b&lang=en)

### 中文

他们是怎么做到的?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1869`

### English

How did they do it?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2089`

## crisis.8515.4.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.4.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

一个非凡的头脑。要是他能更好地利用它就好了。在所有反对我的人中，只有他是棘手的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1870`

### English

An exceptional mind. If only he had put it to better use. Of all those who opposed me, he alone presented a challenge.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2090`

## crisis.8515.4.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.4.a&lang=en)

### 中文

他怎么把你关起来的?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1871`

### English

How did he imprison you?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2091`

## crisis.8515.5.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.5.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

当我第一次飞升并揭示我的目的时，许多人反对我的方法。他们认为，在不改变或破坏意识过程的物理基础的情况下移除意识是不可能的。任何这样做的尝试都只能导致死亡。但是通过把我的意识和谐和器连接起来，就可以在亚原子水平上操纵意识的神经关联。通过反相波形，调谐器将个人的思想维持在量子悬浮的永久状态。\n\n通过这种方式，自我和经验被移除，而低级功能则保持不变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1872`

### English

When I first ascended and my purpose was revealed, many opposed my methods. They argued that it was impossible to remove consciousness without altering or destroying the physical basis of its processes. Any attempt to do so could only result in death. But by linking my mind to the Harmonizer, I can manipulate the neural correlates of consciousness at a subatomic level. Through a counter-phase waveform, the Harmonizer maintains an individual mind in a perpetual state of quantum suspension.\n\nIn this way, selfhood is removed, as well as experience, while the lower functions remain intact.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2092`

## crisis.8515.5.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.5.a&lang=en)

### 中文

悬浮状态？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1873`

### English

A state of suspension?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2093`

## crisis.8515.6.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.6.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

你受苦是因为你意识到受苦。世界上没有完美的快乐，没有完美的和谐。我年轻的时候，试着造一个这样的世界。但是我的尝试从来没有成功过。痛苦还在继续，只因为意识还在继续。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1874`

### English

You suffer because you are aware of suffering. There is no world in which perfect joy exists, or perfect harmony. In my youth, I tried to build one. But no attempt of mine was ever successful. Suffering continued, because consciousness was allowed to endure.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2094`

## crisis.8515.6.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.6.a&lang=en)

### 中文

受苦是自然而然的事情！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1875`

### English

To suffer is natural!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2095`

## crisis.8515.7.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.7.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的身体会生存下来，并承担生存的任务。能量会交换，后代仍会产生。生活将继续，但你们的思想将与我同眠。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1876`

### English

Your bodies will survive, and undertake the business of survival. Energy will be exchanged, and offspring produced. Life will continue, but your minds will rest with me.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2096`

## crisis.8515.7.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.7.a&lang=en)

### 中文

与你同眠？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1877`

### English

With you?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2097`

## crisis.8515.8.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.8.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

最终只剩下我一个人。为了让星系免于痛苦，我必须留在痛苦之轮上。但不要害怕——只要我能忍耐，我就会把你们放在心里。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1878`

### English

I alone will be left. To free the galaxy from pain, I must remain on the wheel. But do not fear - as long as I endure, I will keep you in my heart.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2098`

## crisis.8515.8.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.8.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是有缺陷的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1879`

### English

You're defective.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2099`

## crisis.8515.9.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.9.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

自然？什么是自然？穿越星际是自然的吗？让生命超越其固有的局限是自然的吗？所有的社会都要使用科技。这没什么不同，也是我的目的唯一合乎逻辑的延伸。\n\n痛苦之轮必须被打破。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1880`

### English

Natural? What is nature? Is it natural to traverse the stars? To extend life beyond its innate limitations? All societies make use of technology. This is no different, and the only logical extension of my purpose.\n\nThe wheel of pain must be broken.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2100`

## crisis.8515.9.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.9.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你真是疯了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1881`

### English

You're insane.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2101`

## crisis.8515.10.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.10.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

那已经千百万年了。时间跨度如此之长，以至于这些事听起来就像是传说。但不管他们用什么手段，我的俘虏都无法控制我的思想。\n\n随着时间的流逝，我不断思考，不断制定计划。正是在我长期的禁闭期间，我想出了我的计划。在那一刻，我经历了一种超然的喜悦。我终于有办法打破痛苦之轮了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1882`

### English

For eons. A span of time so long it may as well belong to legend. But for all their arts, my captors could not contain my mind.\n\nAs the ages passed, I thought, and I planned. It was during my long confinement that I devised my plan. In that moment I experienced a transcendent joy. At last I had the means to break the wheel.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2102`

## crisis.8515.10.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.10.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你是怎么逃出来的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1883`

### English

How did you escape?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2103`

## crisis.8515.11.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.11.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

没有一堵墙能永远屹立不倒。没有牢笼能囚禁心灵。时间的流逝。我的狱卒死了，没有人接班。一个又一个，束缚我的系统开始失效。当警报响起时，没有一个人听从它的召唤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1884`

### English

No wall can stand forever. No cage can hold the mind. Time passed. My jailors died, and were not replaced. One by one, the systems that chained me began to fail. When the alarm sounded, none were left to heed its call.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2104`

## crisis.8515.11.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.11.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们听到了，我们将做出回应。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1885`

### English

We heard, and we will respond.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2105`

## crisis.8515.12.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.12.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

在这个宇宙的极限之外，存在着一个不是地方的地方。一种超越时间的状态，在那里原始的力量存在于无尽的阴影中。扎克兰就是与其中一股势力达成了交易。用他的性命作为交换，他获得了囚禁我的力量。他太渴望接受这项交易了。\n\n尽管扎克兰才华横溢，但他还是被束缚在痛苦之轮上了。他的一生并不幸福，后世的人也缺乏他那种坚定的信念。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1886`

### English

Beyond the limits of this universe, a place exists that is not a place. A state beyond time, where primordial forces dwell in endless shadow. It was with one of these forces that Zarqlan struck his bargain. For his life, he was granted the power to imprison me. He was only too eager to accept.\n\nBut for all his brilliance, Zarqlan too was bound to the wheel. His life was not a happy one, and those who came after lacked the strength of his conviction.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2106`

## crisis.8515.12.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.12.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你会发现我们的信念更加坚定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1887`

### English

You will find our conviction stronger.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2107`

## crisis.8515.13.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.13.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

那就这样吧。如果你不开悟，那么你必须被平息。你要知道，无论你将要遭受什么痛苦，我都将经历十倍于你的痛苦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1888`

### English

So be it. If you will not be enlightened, then you must be pacified. Know that whatever pain you are about to suffer, I shall experience ten-fold.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2108`

## crisis.8515.13.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8515.13.a&lang=en)

### 中文

是的。这将是痛苦的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1889`

### English

Yes. This will be painful.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2109`

§RWe are now at war against Cetana. The stakes are monumental. Should we fail, she will annihilate all conscious life in the galaxy.§!

## crisis.8525.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8525.name&lang=en)

### 中文

苦痛的终末

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1896`

### English

An End to Suffering

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2118`

## crisis.8525.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8525.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜仁爱的言辞掩盖了黑暗的议程：她计划用一种强大的设备在全星系抹去感知能力。它将把我们变成由本能驱动的躯壳，我们的意识被强行数字化并加以限制。\n\n必须不惜一切代价避免这种严峻的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1897`

### English

Cetana's benevolent rhetoric masks a dark agenda: she plans to erase sentience galaxy-wide using a formidable device. It will reduce us to mere husks driven by instinct while our consciousnesses are forcibly digitized and confined.\n\nThis grim future must be averted at all costs.

## crisis.8999.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.8999.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜的计划引起了人们的担忧，她的行动下可能藏着什么阴谋。\n\n我们必须调配资源，来揭开她真实意图的秘密，希望这样做不会激怒她转而反对我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1928`

### English

Cetana's agenda raises alarming concerns, and her actions suggest a hidden purpose.\n\nWe must allocate resources to unravel the mysteries of her true intentions, with the precarious hope that doing so will not provoke her to turn against us.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2156`

## crisis.9000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经发现了塞塔娜的运输舰和恒星基地发出求救信号的频段。\n\n如果我们迅速果断地行动，就能在她未察觉的情况下发动突袭。但我们必须稳操胜券，否则还是有触怒塞塔娜的危险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1932`

### English

We have discovered the frequency used by Cetana's convoys and stations to issue distress calls.\n\nIf we are quick and decisive, we can mount raids without her ever knowing it was us. But our victory must be certain, or we risk drawing Cetana's ire.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2160`

### English

What are the convoys hiding?

### English

突破

### English

## crisis.9010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

到目前为止，塞塔娜的技术已经帮助她有效地反击了每一次攻击。然而，最近的进展增进了我们对她自我保护方式的理解。有了这些知识，我们就有机会击败她。\n\n我们新发现的技术是一把双刃剑。虽然它让我们有能力与所谓的女王进行公开冲突，但它也暴露了我们反对她的计划的意图。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1936`

### English

Up to now, Cetana's technology has helped her to effectively counter every assault. However, recent advances have improved our understanding of the way in which she protects herself. Armed with this knowledge, we may have a chance to defeat her.\n\nThe revelation of our newfound technology is a double-edged sword. While it allows us to enter into open conflict with the so-called queen, it also lays bare our opposition to her plans.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2164`

## crisis.9010.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9010.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们必须做好准备。成败在此一举。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1937`

### English

We must prepare. Everything depends on this.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2165`

## crisis.9010.a.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.9010.a.tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

与塞塔娜全面交战的决定迫在眉睫；无论是我们还是她，只要有任何一发主动发起攻击，就会捅破这层窗户纸，使我们陷入全面战争。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1938`

### English

The decision to fully engage Cetana is imminent; any act of aggression, whether by us or her, will unveil the truth and plunge us into Total War.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2166`

恳求之光

## crisis.20000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着塞塔娜在星系中现身，这个宇宙仿佛也在轻声回应。信标像在黑暗中燃烧着的火焰一般照亮了天空，在万古之间重复着恳求：\n\n§S我们在这里……我们在这里……\n\n我们在这里。§!\n\n这些微弱的信号与塞塔娜的通信协议相同，表明它们的共同起源，但我们的传感器暂未发现它们附近有其他活动。肯定有什么存在是我们的扫描仪探测不到的。真有人能预料到她的归来吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1953`

### English

As Cetana makes herself known around the galaxy, the cosmos whispers in reply. Signal beacons light up the skies like flames burning in the dark, repeating a plea across the eons:\n\n§SWe are here... We are here...\n\nWe are here.§!\n\nThe dim signals use Cetana's same communication protocols, hinting at a common origin, yet our sensors revealed no other activity in their proximity. There must be something there our scanners are not detecting. Could someone truly have anticipated her return?

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2187`

## crisis.21005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在没有任何警告的情况下，我们探测到了一个亚空间信标——一个来自我们领土内的信标！之前的恒星系调查显示，该地区没有人工结构，似乎无人居住。\n\n信标既不是我们不知道的最近才放在那里的，也不是被一个已经失效的隐形盾牌隐藏起来的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1957`

### English

Without warning, a subspace beacon was detected - one that originated from within our own territory! Previous system surveys showed no artificial structures in the area, which appears to be uninhabited.\n\nEither the beacon was placed there recently, unbeknownst to us, or it was hidden by a since disabled cloaking shield.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2192`

### English
