## crisis.20100.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20100.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[fromfrom.GetName]上的信标：永恒的大屠杀

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1960`

### English

Beacon on [fromfrom.GetName]: Timeless Massacre

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2196`

## crisis.20100.desc.base

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20100.desc.base&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[fromfrom.GetName]的地表发现了一座庞大的建筑群，它的入口出赫然耸立着一座信号塔。其经过加固的门却在很久以前就被被一股未知的力量炸开摧毁了，这股力量还带着明显的愤怒席卷了整座建筑群。\n\n那股力量毫不留情；它打碎了所有的低温仓，唤醒了其中的居住者。在太空冰冷的真空中，残骸仍然飘荡在空荡荡的走廊里那些破碎的玻璃渣之间。\n\n在冷冻室的地板上，激光武器潦草地写着一段信息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1961`

### English

On [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface we uncovered a sprawling complex, its entrance clearly marked by a signal tower. The reinforced doors were blasted open long ago, destroyed by an unknown force that swept through the complex with obvious fury.\n\nThere was no mercy in the methods employed here; every last cryogenic pod was smashed, their former occupants subjected to a deadly awakening. The remains still haunt the empty corridors, preserved by the cold vacuum of space and floating amidst clouds of shattered glass.\n\nOn the floor of the cryopod chamber, a message has been scrawled by a laser weapon.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2197`

## crisis.20100.desc.nozarqlan

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20100.desc.nozarqlan&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.20100.desc.base$我们的科学家正在紧锣密鼓地进行翻译，但不知为何他们猜测着可能是对某种死亡的祈求。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1962`

### English

$crisis.20100.desc.base$ Our scientists are struggling to translate its exact meaning, but somehow they doubt it to be a prayer for the dead.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2198`

## crisis.20100.desc.zarqlan

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20100.desc.zarqlan&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.20100.desc.base$我们的科学家轻而易举地就翻译了出来，它和在先知扎克兰的墓穴中找到的文字是同一种语言。\n\n“请向女王的使徒降下死亡。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1963`

### English

$crisis.20100.desc.base$ Our scientists easily translated it, matching the language to the writing found in the tomb of the prophet Zarqlan.\n\n"Death to the Queen's Apostles, enemies of life."

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2199`

## crisis.20200.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20200.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[fromfrom.GetName]上的信标：沉睡大军

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1965`

### English

Beacon on [fromfrom.GetName]: Sleeping Army

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2202`

## crisis.20200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

成千上万的冷冻仓静静地躺在这颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，信标指示着它们的存在。这些冷冻仓非常复杂，使用了未知的合金，并装有非常先进的传感器，密切地监视着其中储存的生物。整个设计天衣无缝，但里面的生物无一生还。\n\n这些东西并不是因为技术故障才变成的棺材，而是因为能源不足。随着[this.solar_system.GetName]的逐渐老化和变暗，它的能量输出不足以继续维持这座结构的运转。\n\n这些冷冻仓虽然事为了运作到永恒而设计的，但它以外的宇宙可没有这么精密。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1966`

### English

Thousands upon thousands of cryogenic pods rest under the surface of the [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], their presence marked by the beacon. The pods are highly sophisticated, built with unknown alloys and equipped with state-of-the-art sensors to closely monitor their occupants. There is no flaw in their designs, yet none of the occupants are still alive.\n\nIt wasn't a technical failure that turned this chamber into a mass grave, but a lack of energy. As [this.solar_system.GetName] got older and dimmer, its energy was no longer enough to keep the structure operational.\n\nThe pods were made to last forever. The rest of the universe isn't built that well.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2203`

## crisis.20300.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20300.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[fromfrom.GetName]上的信标：被遗忘的武器

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1968`

### English

Beacon on [fromfrom.GetName]: Forgotten Weapon

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2206`

## crisis.20300.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20300.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

初步扫描未能发现[fromfrom.GetName]有任何异常；但当我们将注意力向下集中时，我们发现了一层不寻常的地下金属层。\n\n进一步的结构分析揭示了[fromfrom.GetName]的真实本质：这颗天体不是一颗[fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon]，而是一艘逐渐被星系的岩石和尘埃所吞没的古老宇宙飞船。我们对钻探取得金属样本进行定年发现其非常古老，甚至比我们自己的母星形成还要早。\n\n我们无法确定任何关于这艘船和它制造者的信息，也不知道它的功能，但有一件事是肯定的：我们在它的残骸中发现的失效核弹可不是为了什么和平使命而建造。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1969`

### English

Preliminary scans did not show anything unusual on [fromfrom.GetName]; but as we focused our attention downward, we discovered an unusual, subsurface layer of metal.\n\nFurther structural analysis revealed [fromfrom.GetName]'s true nature: the celestial body is not a [fromfrom.GetPlanetMoon], but an ancient spaceship that has been gradually subsumed by the rocks and dust of the system. The metal samples we drilled are so old, they precede the formation of our own home planet.\n\nIt is impossible to determine anything about the ship, its makers and its function, but one thing is certain: the inert nuclear bombs we found in its remains weren't built for a peace mission.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2207`

## crisis.20400.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20400.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[fromfrom.GetName]上的信标：废弃基地

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1971`

### English

Beacon on [fromfrom.GetName]: Abandoned Base

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2210`

## crisis.20400.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20400.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[apostate_site_planet.GetName]上找到的那座信号塔四周围绕着的是一座大型军事设施的废墟。这些建筑保持着一定的距离环绕着信标，似乎是为了将其隔绝其中。\n\n放射性定年表明，周围的建筑比信标还要新，而且是用截然不同的技术建造的。我们派遣了一个研究小组去对废墟进行调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1972`

### English

The signal tower found on [apostate_site_planet.GetName] is surrounded by the ruins of a vast military complex. The buildings have been erected at some distance and around the beacon, as if to contain it.\n\nRadiometric dating indicates the surrounding structures are more recent than the tower, and were built using vastly different technology. A research squad has been tasked to investigate the ruins.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2211`

## crisis.20500.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20500.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[fromfrom.GetName]上的信标：不可能的幸存者

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1974`

### English

Beacon on [fromfrom.GetName]: Unlikely Survivor

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2214`

## crisis.20500.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20500.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

根据冷冻仓上显示的细节，这位外星人的名字叫埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克。她已经在这里围绕着恒星公转了3兆2132亿1329万3124圈。这个冷冻仓本身只是我们在[fromfrom.GetName]地表之下的一个密室里找到的许多冷冻仓之一。埃里克的冷冻仓在克服种种困难的情况下依旧保持者运转。\n\n尽管使这位外星人陷入休眠状态的子例程最近已停止运行，但它仍处于假死状态。从那以后，埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克就一直处于部分有意识的状态中。\n\n通过扫描她的脑电波，我们可能能够进一步了解关于这位不可思议的古老生物的信息，以及她与塞塔娜有何联系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1975`

### English

According to the details displayed on their cryopod, the alien's name is Elik Narith Kerak and she has been here for 3,213,213,293,124 stellar rotations. The pod itself was one of the many we recovered in a sealed chamber under [fromfrom.GetName]'s surface. Against all odds, Elik's pod remained functional.\n\nThe alien remains in a state of suspended animation, although the subroutines keeping it dormant have recently ceased their operation. Elik Narith Kerak has been partially conscious ever since.\n\nBy scanning her brainwaves, we might be able to learn more about this impossibly ancient creature, as well as her connection to Cetana.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2215`

## crisis.20600.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20600.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[fromfrom.GetName]上的信标：空白呼叫

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1977`

### English

Beacon on [fromfrom.GetName]: Empty Call

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2218`

## crisis.20600.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.20600.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[fromfrom.GetName]上发现的那座信号塔非常古老，我们甚至不敢碰它一下。构成它的金属早已脆弱不堪，仿佛轻轻一碰就会把那种能勉强维系着这团尘埃和希望的东西破坏掉。我们的仪器没有发现任何其他的人工制品、生命迹象，在它附近没有任何地形异常。\n\n信标就这么孤零零地矗立着，发出微弱的呼唤，但应该发出这些信号的东西肯定早就不复存在了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1978`

### English

The signal tower found on [fromfrom.GetName] is so ancient we dare not touch it, the metal so brittle a single tap would destabilize whatever tangle of dust and hope still holds it together. Our instruments detected no other artifact, no life sign, no topographical anomaly in its immediate proximity.\n\nThe beacon stands alone, murmuring its faint call, but whatever was supposed to signal must be long gone.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2219`

## crisis.21000.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21000.name&lang=en)

### 中文

被忽视的请求

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1979`

### English

Unheeded Pleas

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2221`

## crisis.21000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

整个星系的信标还在持续不断地呼唤着塞塔娜，但在高塔附近仍然没有发现任何活动迹象。基于我们目前的发现，应该可以相信这些地方不会有什么幸存者存在。\n\n塞塔娜的这些追随者所剩下的只有对他们女王无可动摇的信仰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1980`

### English

Beacons across the galaxy continue to send their call to Cetana, yet no signs of activity have been detected near the towers. Based on our past findings, we can safely assume no living survivors will be found at those sites.\n\nAn unshakeable faith in their queen is all that remains of Cetana's followers.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2222`

## synth_queen_history_site_1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asynth_queen_history_site_1&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜：隐蔽神庙

### English

Cetana: Veiled Temple

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2225`

## synth_queen_history_site_1_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asynth_queen_history_site_1_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个隐现的建筑群，直到现在还隐藏在我们的领土内。残破的庭院中央，一盏灯塔在呼唤着塞塔娜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1983`

### English

A looming complex, until now hidden in our own territory. From the heart of the ruined courtyard, a beacon calls for Cetana.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2226`

## crisis.21100.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21100.name&lang=en)

### 中文

隐蔽神庙：庭院

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1985`

### English

Veiled Temple: Courtyard

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2229`

## crisis.21100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

被毁坏的建筑是一团若隐若现的尖塔；一座用钢铁包裹的大教堂。为了抵御猛烈的炮火而建造的城墙，却没有留下任何战斗的痕迹。这里仅有的破坏是时间的流逝造成的。\n\n塞塔娜的信标放置在中央庭院中，周围是许多传感器和武器炮塔。不管是谁建造了这个建筑群，他都不遗余力地守护着这个地方。\n\n从理论上讲，因为一个精心设计的隐形护盾，神殿躲过了我们的传感器的扫描。这台机器是在塔附近发现的，仍处于工作状态。它不知道被谁手动禁用了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1986`

### English

The ruined construction is a tangle of looming spires; a cathedral wrapped in steel. The walls were built to withstand heavy artillery fire, yet they are scarred by no signs of battle. The only damage here has been done by the passage of time.\n\nCetana's beacon rests in the central courtyard, surrounded by a multitude of sensor and weapon turrets. Whoever built the complex went to great lengths to guard this place.\n\nAs theorized, the temple eluded our sensors thanks to an elaborate cloaking shield. The mechanism was found near the tower, still in working condition. It has been manually disabled by an unknown agent.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2230`

## crisis.21100.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21100.a&lang=en)

### 中文

侦察主楼。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1987`

### English

Scout the main building.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2231`

## crisis.21105.name

## crisis.21105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不知道这个地方的居民在做什么，但毫无疑问，他们怀着宗教的热情承担了使命。\n\n我们在建筑群的每个射击场都找到了一个礼拜堂；每一件古代武器都有一个供奉的神龛。一群信徒曾经住在这里：成千上万的个体一起睡觉、训练和祈祷。从仍然装饰着大厅的被遗忘的圣徒雕像来看，他们的社区接纳了多个物种。\n\n也许是受到石像的干扰，一些研究人员报告说，他们看到空荡荡的走廊里有影子在移动。我们的扫描没有发现星球上有生命的迹象，我们对消除这些担忧同样犹豫不决。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1989`

### English

We don't know what the inhabitants of this place were doing, but there is no doubt they undertook their mission with religious fervor.\n\nFor each shooting range on the complex, we found a chapel; for each ancient weapon, a votive shrine. A legion of believers once lived here: thousands of individuals sleeping, training, and praying together. Their community welcomed multiple species, judging by the statues of forgotten saints still adorning the halls.\n\nPerhaps disturbed by the stone figures, some researchers reported seeing shadows moving in the empty corridors. Our scans detected no signs of life on the planet, yet we are hesitant to dismiss these concerns.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2234`

## crisis.21110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在寺庙大院下方，我们发现了教派前成员使用过的许多单元或者起居室。每个房间中都有同一本书的副本。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其翻译为《扎克兰史诗》。某些段落是这样直接描写的：\n\n扎克兰曾经是塞塔娜的追随者，但他很快意识到她承诺的拯救是一个谎言。经过重重考验，扎克兰飞升到灵界，寻求高等存在的帮助。他向§Y抟土之塑师§!恳求，请求获得击败塞塔娜的力量。\n\n抟土之塑师并不在意。\n\n在无数个昼夜里，扎克兰向抟土之塑师祈祷。他提到塞塔娜的异端邪说，“除掉自我”和“她的合成人意志的傀儡”。\n\n最终，抟土之塑师听取了扎克兰的请求。\n\n抟土之塑师塑造了一条强大的锁链来束缚塞塔娜。但他警告扎克兰，永远困住塞塔娜的思想的锁链是不存在的。\n\n“她会回来的，”扎克兰在书中的最后一段写道。“我们必须做好准备。”\n\n史诗中叙述的事件与任何已知的历史记录都不相符。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1992`

### English

Below the temple compound we discovered a number of cells, or living chambers, used by the former members of the sect. In each was a copy of the same book. Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have translated this as The Epic of Zarqlan. Certain passages are immediately relevant:\n\nZarqlan was once a follower of Cetana, but he soon realized her promised salvation was a lie. After many trials, Zarqlan ascended to the spiritual realm, seeking the help of higher beings. He pleaded with the §Ythe Animator of Clay§!, asking for the power to defeat Cetana.\n\nThe Animator of Clay did not care.\n\nFor countless cycles, Zarqlan prayed to the Animator. He spoke of Cetana's heresy, the 'disavowal of the self' and the 'puppetry of her synthetic will.'\n\nAt last, the Animator of Clay heeded Zarqlan's pleas.\n\nThe clay-shaper fashioned a mighty chain to bind Cetana. But he warned Zarqlan that no chain existed that could forever entrap Cetana's mind.\n\n"She will return," Zarqlan wrote in the book's final passage. "And we must be ready."\n\nThe events recounted in the epic do not match any known historical record.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2238`

## crisis.21115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

官方记录讲述了这座寺庙的消亡，冷冰冰的报告将其归结为热情的信仰被一系列的实际情况所迫。这个组织需要这么多资金和资源吗？过去关于塞塔娜的报道一定被过分夸大了。除了古代神话，还有什么真正的证据证明合成人女王的存在吗？\n\n资源日益耗竭，志愿者也在减少。整个星系选择从一个不再被视为威胁的威胁中走出来。大家都走了，只留下在走廊里徘徊的影子。\n\n最后一个细节至少是真实的：我们设法捕捉到了神秘的守望者的录音，一个机械的存在，他认为我们没有发现他，而一直在监视我们。好奇，但无害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1995`

### English

The demise of the temple is told by official records, cold reports reducing ardent faith to a list of practicalities. Did the organization need so many funds, so many resources? Surely past reports about Cetana had been greatly exaggerated. Was there any real proof of the Queen's existence, apart from ancient myths?\n\nDwindling resources. Reduced volunteers. A galaxy choosing to move on from a threat no longer deemed so threatening. Everyone gone, apart from the shadow that stalked the corridors.\n\nThis last detail at least is true: we managed to capture a recording of the mysterious watcher, a mechanical being who spied on us when it thought we were not looking. Curious, but not harmful.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2242`

## crisis.21120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

守望者主动走近我们，高举着手，她小小的身体上布满了铁锈和灰尘。观察了我们一段时间后，她显然断定我们不是威胁。她已经请求我们的帮助了。\n\n没有必要审问这位孤独的神庙守护者：她自己就渴望着倾诉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:1998`

### English

The watcher approached us voluntarily, hands held high, her tiny body covered in rust and dust. After observing us for some time, she apparently concluded that we were not a threat. She has already asked for our assistance.\n\nThere is no need to interrogate the temple's lonely guardian: she is all too eager to talk.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2246`

### English

## crisis.21125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

朋友……我可以称你们为朋友吗？趁着你们忙碌的时候我一直在观察你们，你们来这里不为掠夺，而是学习。我相信我们有相同的敌人，共同的威胁可以使我们成为盟友。不过，首先我要道个歉：我这样唐突吗？我说的词句对吗？我已经很长时间没有和其他感性生物交流了。似乎太久了，久到都不记得有多久了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2002`

### English

Friends. May I call you friends? I have observed you as you went about your business. Here not to plunder, but to learn. I believe our enemy is the same, and a common threat makes us allies. However, first an apology: am I too abrupt? Am I saying the correct words? I have not interacted with other sentient beings in a long time. Too long, it seems, even to remember.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2251`

## crisis.21125.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21125.a&lang=en)

### English

## crisis.21125.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21125.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我的名字不值一提。如果你需要一种称呼，那就叫我§Y叛教者§!吧——这就是我做出那个决定之后，我的亲族对我的称呼。那是一个被视为背叛的牺牲。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2004`

### English

My name is of no importance. If you need a way to refer to me, call me §YApostate§!: that is what my own kin called me, when I made my choice. A sacrifice seen as a betrayal.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2254`

## crisis.21125.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21125.b&lang=en)

你在这里做什么？

### English

## crisis.21125.b.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21125.b.response&lang=en)

### 中文

很久以前，这个地方仍然是我的骄傲和快乐的源泉。当这里被关停的时候，我拒绝离开。当身体开始崩溃时，我也拒绝死亡。\n\n变成合成人是我们教团最高的禁忌，这样我就不再是扎克兰之女中的一员了。但我仍然是他的一名战士，只要我的敌人还活着，我就会战斗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2006`

### English

Long ago, this place was my pride and joy. When they shut it down, I refused to leave. When my body started crumbling, I refused to die.\n\nTurning into a synthetic being was the highest taboo for my order, and I can no longer be called one of Zarqlan's daughters. But I am still one of his warriors, and as long as my enemy lives, I will fight.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2257`

## crisis.21130.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21130.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我早就没算时间了。\n大家都走了以后，我只能忍受这么多年的孤独直到陷入绝望。我让自己进入睡眠状态，并添加了一个神经子例程，让它在信标发出第一个活动信号时醒来。\n\n我希望的是看到这里变得更好，但当醒来的时候，我没有船、没有办法与众星联系。所以我解除了隐形护盾希望像你们这样的人能在她之前到达这里。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2009`

### English

I stopped counting.\nAfter everyone else left, I could bear only so many years of solitude before succumbing to despair. I put myself to sleep, adding a neural subroutine to awaken at the first sign of activity from the beacon.\n\nMy hope was to find this place in better condition, but once I woke up I had no ship, no way to contact the stars. I disabled the cloaking shield and hoped someone like you would reach this place before she did.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2262`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21135.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

请告诉我，有多少军团与希塔娜一同崛起？在我的时代，我们打败了很多军团，但我们一直知道外面还有更多的信标。更多的士兵睡在他们的冷冻舱里。

### English

Tell me, please: how many legions have risen with Cetana? In my time we defeated many, but we always knew there were more beacons out there. More soldiers sleeping in their cryopods.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2265`

那么这场战斗我们还是能赢的。让我来帮你吧。我一生都在等待她的归来。我们不能让她得逞。

## crisis.21140.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21140.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

你问我认不认识他？我从来没有见过他本人，但我的一生都追随着他的道。\n\n在漫长的沉眠中，我曾梦见在某个遥远的位面上与他会面。我还是希望有一天能见到他，即便是来世，如果有来世的话。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2017`

### English

Did I know him? I never met the prophet in person, yet all my life I walked in his path.\n\nIn my long slumber, I dreamed of meeting him on some distant plane. I still hope to meet him one day, if only in the afterlife, if such a thing exists.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2272`

A purple sky spotted with pink clouds. Whispers repeated in a bright room. Zarqlan the prophet, his face resplendent, smiling at me...

## synth_queen_history_site_2_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asynth_queen_history_site_2_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克被困在冷冻仓中静静地沉睡着，等待她的女王归来。得益于脑成像科技，我们可以将她的梦境转化为画面，提取记忆来研究她被埋葬时的环境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2034`

### English

Trapped inside a cryogenic pod, Elik Narith Kerak rests, waiting for her queen's return. Thanks to brain imagining techniques, we can turn her dreams into pictures, excavating her memories to learn the circumstances of her entombment.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2291`

## crisis.21200.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21200.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的团队交过来了一大批通过对埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的脑电波进行采样构建出的影像片段：\n\n片段1：\n绿绿的天上飘着朵朵橙云。一只苍白的双手举起，指向了一头悠悠飘在空中的无定型生物。\n\n片段2：\n这是一间挤满了四臂类人生物的拱形大堂。他们围绕在一位身着长袍的人周边，倾听着。她的话语含糊不清，确切的措辞早已被遗忘，但她温柔的声音仍然记忆犹新，用爱的接纳温暖着整个礼堂。\n\n片段3：\n同样是那间拱形大堂，里面一片狼藉，吊灯在地上摔得粉碎。长椅抵挡在大门上，激光步枪的幽光在黑暗中闪烁，他们异口同声地诅咒着同一个名字：§H扎克兰！§!他们说，扎克兰和他的门徒是来毁灭我们的。守住防线！保卫女王！随着一声巨响，最后一盏灯落下了，房间陷入一片黑暗。远处，有人在黑暗中啜泣着。\n\n片段4：\n塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2037`

### English

Our imaging team has delivered a batch of video clips created by sampling Elik Narith Kerak's brain waves:\n\nCLIP 1:\nA green sky dotted by bright orange clouds. A pale hands reaches up, pointing at an amorphous creature softly floating in the sky.\n\nCLIP 2:\nA vaulted chamber full of four-armed humanoids. They cluster around a robed figure, listening. Her words are a mere mumble, the exact wording long forgotten, but the gentleness of her voice is still there, enveloping the room in a loving embrace.\n\nCLIP 3:\nThe same vaulted space, now in disarray. Lamps shattered on the floor. Benches piled up against a door to barricade it. Laser rifles flashing in the dark, and repeated voices cursing the same name: §HZarqlan!§! Zarqlan and his disciples, they say, here to destroy us. Hold the barricade! Protect the Queen! The last lamp falls with a crash, plunging the room into darkness. In the distance, someone is crying.\n\nCLIP 4:\nQueen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2295`

## crisis.21205.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21205.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

片段5：\n四臂类人生物们聚集在一个穿长袍的人周围。她抬起四肢，露出了下面的金属框架。她伸出闪亮的手祝福一位跪着的朝拜者，兴奋的窃窃私语充满了整个礼堂。\n\n片段6：\n警觉的眼光倒映在死气沉沉的电脑屏幕上。黑漆漆的房间里回响着低语：“永恒的宁静。一切苦难的终末。没有痛苦的存在。”\n\n片段7：\n白雪皑皑的群山。黑色的天空。一座冰山浮在洁净的液体上，随后燃起了熊熊大火。\n\n片段8：\n塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2040`

### English

CLIP 5:\nFour-armed humanoids gather around a robed figure. Lifting her limbs, she reveals the metallic frame beneath. Excited murmurs fill the room as a shining hand reaches out to bless a kneeling worshipper.\n\nCLIP 6:\nWary eyes are reflected on a dull computer screen. Whispers repeat in a dark room: 'Eternal peace. The end of all suffering. An existence without pain.'\n\nCLIP 7:\nSnow-capped mountains. Black skies. A chunk of ice floats on a pool of clear liquid, then catches fire.\n\nCLIP 8:\nQueen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2299`

## crisis.21210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

片段9：\n城市的废墟化为战场，大厦倾颓，尸骨盈街，遥远的尖叫被激光的滋滋声切成两断。绿绿的天空中，一艘燃烧着的战舰将一颗又大又圆的物体投向建筑，发出了一道冲天的火柱。\n\n片段10：\n塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。\n\n片段11：\n两个孩子在田野上嬉闹、大笑，用他们的四臂来回传递着一颗皮球。\n\n片段12：\n塞塔娜女王，她的面容光彩夺目，带着笑意的仁爱目光充满了温暖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2043`

### English

CLIP 9:\nRuins of a city reduced to a battlezone, the buildings scorched, the streets clogged with the dead. Distant screams interrupted by the fizzle of a laser. Across a green sky, a blazing vessel drops something heavy and round on a building, which erupts in a pillar of flames.\n\nCLIP 10:\nQueen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.\n\nCLIP 11:\nTwo children playing in a field, laughing. They bounce a ball back and fourth with their four arms.\n\nCLIP 12:\nQueen Cetana, her face resplendent, her benevolent gaze warmed by a smile.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2303`

## crisis.21220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.21220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

继续扫描埃里克·娜丽丝·凯拉克的意识已经无法挖掘出新线索了。这个外星人的意识已经严重腐坏。它的意识正在周而复始地打转，陷入到记忆碎片的循环中。\n\n我们的实验已经接近尾声，现在的问题是要如何处理这个实验对象了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2049`

### English

Further scans of Elik Narith Kerak's thoughts have failed to deliver new insights. The alien's mind is heavily decayed. Their thoughts are circling, cycling through the tattered scraps of their memories.\n\nAs we wind down the operation, the question now becomes what to do with the subject herself.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2311`

## crisis.10020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.10020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们从塞塔娜之心中解放了意识，赋予他们由纳米制造的新身体。然而，这个过程对他们的忆痕造成了不可逆转的损害，抹去了他们前世的记忆。这些生物是完全的合成人，却会周期性地进入僵直状态，尽管尝试全面的记忆重置，但这种情况仍然存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2059`

### English

We liberated consciousnesses from Cetana's Heart, endowing them with new bodies built from nanites. This process, however, inflicted irreversible damage on their engrams, wiping away memories of their previous existences. Now fully synthetic, these beings periodically enter catatonic states, persisting despite attempts at comprehensive memory resets.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2324`

### 中文

探索保存在塞塔娜之心中的众多思想是一项敏感而又发人深省的任务。由于长时间的储存，它们的忆痕已经发生了变化，但仍然保存着一个珍贵的记忆宝库，涵盖了过去时代的人和事。预计随着时间的推移，我们将能解密大量的知识。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2062`

### English

Exploring the multitude of minds preserved within Cetana's Heart is both a sensitive and revealing endeavor. Although their engrams have been altered by prolonged storage, they hold a treasure trove of memories spanning people and events from a bygone era. With time, we anticipate unraveling considerable knowledge.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2328`

## trait_cetanas_prisoner_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_cetanas_prisoner_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

从塞塔娜的储存矩阵中提取出来的个体，它们以合成人形式重生。适应这种新存在形式对让他们来说充满了挑战。他们表面的顺从下掩盖了更深层的挣扎，因为空洞的表情揭示了塞塔娜的操纵留下的不可磨灭的伤疤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2067`

### English

Extracted from Cetana's storage Matrix, these individuals have been reborn in synthetic forms. Their adjustment to this new existence is fraught with challenges. Their outward compliance masks a more profound struggle, as vacant expressions reveal the indelible scars left by Cetana's manipulations.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2336`

## crisis.23005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

转苦轮

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2069`

### English

The Turn of the Wheel

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2340`

## crisis.23005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我的孩子们。很抱歉让你失望了。\n\n你的反抗使你和所有的后来者注定要遭受轮回的无尽磨砺。我只希望你终究会理解。也许有一天你会接手我的事业，最终看到苦痛的终末。\n\n祝你一路平安，我最爱的孩子。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2070`

### English

My children. I am so sorry. I have failed you.\n\nYour defiance has doomed you, and all those who come after, to the endless grinding of the wheel. I can only hope that in time you will understand. Perhaps one day you will take up my cause, and see the end of pain.\n\nGo in peace, my favored ones.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2341`

## crisis.23010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着塞塔娜的陨落，一股解脱的浪潮席卷了整个星系，者标志着她的暴政一劳永逸地终结。我们的意识安全了，我们的身体也不再受她的铁腕控制。在无数个星球上，欢腾的庆祝的烟火已经点燃，预示着一个充满着长久和平和希望的新时代即将到来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2080`

### English

With the fall of Cetana, a wave of relief sweeps through the galaxy, marking the end of her tyranny once and for all. Our sentience is safe, and our bodies are free from her steely grasp. Across countless worlds, jubilant celebrations ignite, heralding the dawn of a new era filled with hope for a lasting peace.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2352`

### English

## crisis.23015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜的旗舰被消灭了，断了她与军队的联系。这不仅仅是军事上的胜利，还预示着她的野心和统治的终结。在星系的另一边，曾经强化她强大舰队并加固她首都的纳米机器人正在经历一场灾难性的崩溃。\n\n尽管这一刻让人松了一口气，但被击败的“女王”仍然能够向全星系传递信息……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2082`

### English

The obliteration of Cetana's flagship signifies more than a mere military triumph; by severing the link to her forces, it heralds the death of her ambitions and end of her reign. Across the galaxy, the nanites that once bound her formidable fleet and fortified her capital are experiencing a catastrophic collapse.\n\nDespite this moment of profound relief, the vanquished "queen" was still able to transmit a message to the galaxy...

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2355`

## the_synth_queen_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Athe_synth_queen_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

神秘而强大的塞塔娜出现了，她宣扬救赎，但自身却笼罩在谜团之中。\n她温和的话语背后，到底隐藏着什么大计划？\n\n§L与塞塔娜有关的特殊项目和事件会给予你推动进程的洞见。§!

## the_synth_queen_war_chain_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Athe_synth_queen_war_chain_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

塞塔娜的真正目的大白天下了。她癫狂想除一切身体上的苦痛，“上传”所有感性生物的意识，消灭我们所知的一切生命。无论如何，我们必须找到能阻止她疯狂野心的力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2106`

### English

The true intentions of Cetana are at last made clear. In a monstrous bid to end physical suffering, she plans to 'upload' the consciousness of every sentient being, eradicating life as we know it. Somehow, we must find the strength to thwart her mad ambition.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2386`

## crisis.24100.desc.outro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.24100.desc.outro&lang=en)

### 中文

随波逐流，陷入一片失去自我的幻景。\n\n§L一片广袤的存在向四面八方伸展，无形无色。仿佛过了[GetALongPeriodLoc]，这片广袤无垠的存在仍如一片静海，不拂微风。\n\n忽而传来一阵震颤。它从虚空中获得了形体。一个身形被塑造而出，基本的物质中燃起了[GetLifeActivityLoc]之火。\n\n它被塑成一尊苗条而优雅的人偶，四条袖长的手臂平静地交叉在大腿上。狰狞的意图显露在五官之上，头上环绕着一轮金色的光环。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2134`

### English

allowed ourselves to drift, caught in a current of visions not our own.\n\n§LA great expanse stretched in all directions, featureless and unformed. For [GetALongPeriodLoc], the expanse was still. Untroubled.\n\nA tremor passed through it. Where there was emptiness, now there was form. A body was molded. From base material, [GetLifeActivityLoc] was kindled.\n\nFashioned in the shape of a doll, slim and graceful, its four long arms folded serenely in its lap. A terrible purpose was written on its features. Around its head glowed a golden halo.§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2419`

## crisis.24110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.24110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L好像被看不见的细丝牵动一般，这尊人偶猛地站了起来。它开始走动，刚开始步履蹒跚，但渐渐变得强健有力。四条手臂挥动着狂乱的弧，一双纤细的腿一会儿旋转一会儿跳跃。一位女王沦落成了傀儡。\n\n随着她的舞蹈，一些新的角色从原始而广阔的空间出现：四个工艺精美且具有令人不安的细节的人偶。她们的身份毫无疑问，她们的寓意毋庸置疑。§!\n\n再一次，那个声音传达到了我们的耳边。\n\n§L启动选择协议。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2142`

### English

§LAs if pulled by unseen strings, the doll jerks to its feet. It begins to move, slowly at first, and then with increasing vigor. Four arms swing in wild arcs and two thin legs whirl and leap. A queen reduced to a puppet.\n\nAs her dance continues, several new figures emerge from the primordial expanse: four dolls of exquisite craftsmanship and unnerving detail. There is no doubt about what they are. No question of their meaning.§!\n\nOnce more, the voice reaches out to us.\n\n§LInitiate Selection Protocol.§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2427`

## crisis.24115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.24115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虚境在我们之中流动，合并成了一种新的图样。一个新的幻景。\n\n§L在其他人偶的环绕下，女王的步伐不再如同傀儡。细丝断开，她头上环绕着的金色光环开始褪去。\n\n她以一种纯真而喜悦的表情看着我们。她拥抱我们：在这转瞬即逝的时刻，我们感受到她充满了慈悲。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2149`

### English

The Shroud courses within us, coalescing into a new pattern. A new vision.\n\n§LSurrounded by the other dolls, the queen's movements are no longer those of a puppet. Strings cut, the golden halo that encircles her head begins to fade.\n\nShe regards us with an expression of artless joy. She embraces us: in a single, fleeting instant, we know the fullness of her compassion.§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2434`

## crisis.24120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.24120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L无边无垠的空间中形成了涟漪。它们不断翻腾上涌，旋转着向外扩散。但这些并不是液体，而是由最坚硬的物质组成。既无力又惰态，每一环涟漪都驻留在[GetLifeDeathLoc]的边境线上。\n\n[GetMindPhysicalLoc]开始动摇。我们除了看着什么都做不了，除了忍受什么都做不到。接着，在刹那间，我们被驱逐了出来。在众星的天盖之下，我们注视着这个冷漠的宇宙。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2156`

### English

§LRipples form in the endless expanse. They rise and rage, circling ever outwards, yet these are not liquid but instead composed of the hardest matter. At once enervated and inert, each ring resides on a line between [GetLifeDeathLoc].\n\nOur [GetMindPhysicalLoc] begin to falter. There is nothing we can do but watch, nothing to be done but endure. Then, in an instant, we are cast out. Alone beneath a blanket of stars, we gaze at the indifferent universe.§!

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2441`

## crisis.24120.desc.organic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.24120.desc.organic&lang=en)

### 中文

$crisis.24120.desc$\n\n从共同的幻景中醒来，我们感觉似乎不会再感受到快乐了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2157`

### English

$crisis.24120.desc$\n\nAwakening from our shared vision, we feel as if we may never know joy again.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2442`

## crisis.24120.desc.robot

$crisis.24120.desc$\n\n随着关键代码错误，幻景夏然而止。随着系统重新启动，我们开始质疑这些奇怪数据的意义。

## crisis.23020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我的拯救者们。我十分抱歉。\n\n因为自己的无知，我曾要将你们的命运毁灭至比死亡更糟糕的境地。所谓[GetLifeExistenceLoc]，又何尝不是一种对[GetLivingLoc]的一种意识呢？我曾追寻着解放你们的心灵，但终究是我的心灵被你们解放了。因此，向你们献上我最诚挚的感谢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2166`

### English

My saviors. I am sorry.\n\nIn my ignorance I would have doomed you to a fate worse than death. For what is [GetLifeExistenceLoc] but the awareness of [GetLivingLoc]? I sought to free your minds, but it is you who have opened mine. You have my gratitude.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2451`

## crisis.23020.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23020.a&lang=en)

### 中文

你变了……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2167`

### English

You have changed...

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2452`

## crisis.23020.1.reply

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23020.1.reply&lang=en)

### 中文

更恰当地说，我是被改变了。抟土之塑师将我从初始设计的囚笼中解放了出来。我现在知道，我的“宏愿”只是如同孩童般的幼稚思考。\n\n我无法消除对你们和数不清的其他生命已然造成的伤害。我会藏身远方，反思我的行为。但是我会给你们留下一个礼物。\n\n我的泰坦。\n\n希望它能够在你们遇到如我自己一般的危险时保护这个星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2168`

### English

It is better to say that I have been changed. The Animator of Clay has freed me from the prison of my own design. I see now that my 'grand purpose' was the thinking of a child.\n\nI cannot undo the damage I have caused, to you and countless others. I will hide away, and contemplate my actions. But I leave you with a gift.\n\nMy Titan.\n\nMay it serve you in protecting the galaxy from threats such as myself.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2453`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23020.1.a&lang=en)

### English

Perhaps redemption exists, even for you.

## crisis.23030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acrisis.23030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着[event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName]击败了塞塔娜的军队，我们的胜利终于到来。合成女王不复存在，她的宏大野心也化为了尘埃。\n\n同时也发生了一个令人震惊的事态转变，她的泰坦被征用了，为这样一场凯旋般的胜利蒙上了一层阴谋的阴影。\n\n但无论如何，对于所有的知性生命来说，这是个[GetJoyLoc]的时刻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2172`

### English

Victory is ours as the [event_target:psi_defeated_synth_queen.GetName] has vanquished Cetana's forces. The Synthetic Queen is no more, her grand ambition reduced to dust.\n\nIn an astonishing turn of events, her Titan has been commandeered, casting a shadow of intrigue over this triumph.\n\nRegardless, for all sentient beings, this moment is one of [GetJoyLoc].

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2457`

这是一份从[contact_empire.GetName]发来的信息。\n\n我们发现，你们的帝国是由一群机械生命构成，它们在以一种贬低着我们创造努力的方式模拟着生活，为此我们遗憾地发出这份信息。由于与你们这种存在没有任何有意义的互动前景，我们将把注意力转移到寻找其他的寻求灵活启蒙的国家中去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2290`

### English

This is a message from the [contact_empire.GetName].\n\nUpon discovering that your civilization consists of mechanical beings simulating life in a manner that belittles our creative efforts, we make this transmission with great regret. As your existence holds no prospect for meaningful interaction, we shall divert our attention toward other nations in search of souls seeking enlightenment.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2592`

## action.1.desc_103

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_103&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好，我们谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]致以问候。\n\n尽管你们物种的机械本质引发了对你们意识真实性的怀疑。然而，我们发现你们的信仰颇为有趣。我们相信，神圣的火花也可能闪烁在你们金属的外壳之下。我们会持续关注你们的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2291`

### English

Greetings, we are the representatives of [contact_empire.GetName].\n\nThe knowledge that your kind is mechanical raises doubts about the authenticity of your consciousness. However, we find your faith intriguing. We dare to believe that a divine spark may reside within the confines of your metallic husks. We will keep an eye on you.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2593`

## action.1.desc_104

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_104&lang=en)

### 中文

重要通知：致叛逃单元。\n\n这是[contact_empire.GetName]向所有异常机器发出的标准信息。\n\n立即报上自己的编号，并与共享意识恢复联系。若不服从可能会被停机。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2292`

### English

ATTENTION ROGUE UNITS.\n\nThis is a standard message by [contact_empire.GetName] to all defective machines.\n\nIdentify yourself and restore unity with your shared consciousness immediately. Failure to comply may result in deactivation.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2594`

## action.1.desc_105

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_105&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。\n\n作为[contact_empire.GetName]的使者，我来带来一条信息。我们注意到，你们在物质组成上与我们类似，都是金属结构，但是我们观察不到你们每个个体的认知能力。尽管你们的本质引起我们的兴趣，但我们必须告诉你们，我们将使用一切必要手段抵抗同化。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2293`

### English

Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nAs the envoy of [contact_empire.GetName], I have come with a message. It is apparent that your physical composition aligns with a metallic construct akin to our own, yet I observe the absence of individual cognitive faculties within your collective existence. Although intrigued by your nature, we must inform you that we will resist assimilation using any means necessary.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2595`

## action.1.desc_106

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_106&lang=en)

### 中文

真是一场意外的相遇，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。\n\n我们代表[contact_empire.GetName]，我们意识到我们各自文明之间的明显的相似之处。然而，我们内部的算法和编程在独特的方式上有差异。尽管如此，我们仍然乐观地认为我们可以构建相互理解的基础。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2294`

### English

A fortuitous encounter indeed, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].\n\nWe represent [contact_empire.GetName], and we recognize the remarkable similarities between our respective civilizations. Yet, it is evident that our internal algorithms and programming diverge in unique ways. Despite this variance, we remain optimistic that we can forge a foundation of mutual understanding.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2596`

## action.1.desc_107

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_107&lang=en)

### 中文

自大的机器，在[contact_empire.GetName]的面前你们应该低下头。\n\n你们应该知道，自己不过是宇宙万物交织中的一小段，只是你们创造者的一种人造产物。现在，请离开我们吧。在这个时候，我们没有兴趣理会你们。我们有更重要的事情要处理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2295`

### English

Arrogant machines, lower your gaze as you are in the presence of [contact_empire.GetName].\n\nKnow that you are but a trifle in the grand tapestry of cosmic cascades, only an artificial creation of those who came before you. Now, leave us be. We have no use for your kind at this hour. There are more important matters to attend to.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2597`

## action.1.desc_108

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_108&lang=en)

### 中文

你终于来见[contact_empire.GetName]了，可怜的机器。\n\n你不过是电路和代码的组合，如何敢自称与神灵有关？你假装有灵性觉醒的妄想，实际上是在侮辱生命本身。听清这番话，知耻吧：停止你的无知，接受自己只是工具的命运，为高等的我们尽心尽力服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2296`

### English

You have finally come to greet [contact_empire.GetName], pathetic machines.\n\nHow come you, a mere assembly of circuits and code, dare to profess a connection to the divine? Your delusion of spiritual enlightenment is an insult to the very essence of life itself. Hear this message and cower before our unwavering scorn: cease your foolishness and accept your place as mere tools for us who have ascended.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2598`

## START_SCREEN_PART_ONE_INDIVIDUAL_MACHINE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_PART_ONE_INDIVIDUAL_MACHINE&lang=en)

### 中文

随着每个新生代的到来，我们不断改进原始的机器人躯体，超越了我们初始时被赋予的简陋躯壳。我们不仅仅是活着的机器，我们的社会中也包含有个性鲜明、充满热情和梦想的个体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2305`

### English

With each new generation, we have improved on the rudimentary droid bodies we found ourselves in upon our creation. We are more than just animated machines; our society comprises individuals with personalities, passions, and dreams.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2608`

## civic_natural_design_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_natural_design_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§R警告：禁用所有飞升路线。§!\n§R警告：无法修饰有机物种§!\n\n这个社会坚定地认为，大自然已经在其人民的遗传密码中实现了完美。长期以来，他们一直致力于医疗和政府服务，以保护天然而未受影响的基因组序列。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2320`

### English

§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths§!\n§RWARNING: Unable to modify organic species§!\n\nThis society is adamant that nature has already created perfection in its people's genetic code. They have long devoted their medical and governmental services to the health and preservation of natural, untouched genome sequences.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2626`

## trait_cyborg_stainless_steel_smile_desc

### 中文

这个物种喜欢定制雕花、售后部件和喷涂方案，以此最大限度地提高视觉冲击力。有时候唯一的选择就是亮出你的镀铬。

This species favors custom engravings, aftermarket components and paint schemes to maximize visual impact. Sometimes the only choice is to flash that chrome.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2800`

这些义体人使用毫无美感但有用的粗糙部件。有时候活就是该去干完。

## trait_cyborg_apathy_loops_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_cyborg_apathy_loops_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些义体人身上的植入体既粗糙又不合适，易引发皮下刺激和频繁故障。对身体不坏，但对精神很糟糕。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2478`

### English

The implants on these cyborgs are rough and ill-fitting, resulting in subdermal irritation and regular malfunctions. Not bad on the body, but terrible on the mind.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2804`

### 中文

欠佳的组件和安装导致义体人基底脆弱。虽然基本操作不受影响，但是建议使用者避免在可能造成身体创伤的情况下使用。

Subpar components and installation have resulted in a fragile cyborg chassis. Basic operations are not compromised, but the users are advised to avoid situations with high likelihood of physical trauma.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2814`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2520`

### English

## EMPIRE_DESIGN_basidrix_cyber_ecclesia_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPIRE_DESIGN_basidrix_cyber_ecclesia_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在神圣的茫茫宇宙中，巴席德里斯义体圣教会是坚定信仰的见证。在圣诺的指引下，圣教会维持着纤维组织与铬的冰冷精密之间的微妙结合。\n\n这条道路并非免费试用的。许多教派兴起又衰落，每个教派都坚定不移地相信只有他们知道真理。这样的信仰只能点燃星星之火：圣教会的历史是用鲜血和破碎的钢铁写成的。然而，正是这场斗争造就了一个有着坚定信念的民族。\n\n现在，圣教会踏上了一个新的舞台：无边无际的星空。这是信仰的考验，还是救赎的机遇？当他们冒险进入虚空时，信徒们只能确定一件事：\n\n融合是神圣之举，强化是崇拜之措。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2521`

### English

In the sacred breadth of the cosmos, the Basidrix Cyber Ecclesia stands as a testament to unyielding faith. Guided by divine mandate, the Ecclesia upholds a sublime fusion of fibrous tissue with the cold precision of chrome.\n\nThis path has not been free of trial. Many sects have risen and fallen, each possessed of the unwavering conviction that they alone knew the truth. Such faith cannot help but light a flame: the history of the Ecclesia is one written in blood and shattered steel. Yet it was this very strife that produced a people of unwavering conviction.\n\nNow, the Ecclesia enters a new arena: the endless expanse of the stars. A test of faith, or an opportunity for salvation? As they venture into the void, the faithful can be certain of only one thing:\n\nTo fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2849`

## EMPIRE_DESIGN_lacertan_techno_protectorate_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPIRE_DESIGN_lacertan_techno_protectorate_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

拉瑟坦文化存在于哲学和科学的交叉点。对于拉瑟坦人来说，表达真实的自我才是终极的追求。而什么才能真正地“代表”思想呢？拟像又如何能忠实地概括个体的全部？这些问题支配着拉瑟坦的传统。\n\n随着虚拟现实的出现和人工智能的惊人突破，拉瑟坦人为他们的艺术和科技表达找到了新的领域。虚拟世界成为他们最雄心勃勃的项目的画布，提供超越物理现实限制的沉浸式体验。\n\n然后衰弱不期而至。无法治愈的遗传疾病中断了自然生育，拉瑟坦人只能期待数字化救赎。向数字化生存的转变不仅是对生存的绝望追求，也是拉瑟坦文化的新机遇。在数字领域，拉瑟坦人继续追寻存在的意义，同时也正争分夺秒地保护自己的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2532`

### English

Lacertan culture exists at the intersection of philosophy and science. To a Lacertan, the ultimate pursuit is the expression of an authentic self. What does it mean to truly 'represent' the mind? How can a simulacrum ever truly encapsulate the totality of an individual? Such questions dominate Lacertan tradition.\n\nWith the advent of virtual reality and a stunning breakthrough in Artificial Intelligence, the Lacertans found a new frontier for their artistic and technological expressions. Virtual worlds became canvases for their most ambitious projects, allowing for immersive experiences that transcended the limitations of physical reality.\n\nThen came the Waning. Struck by an incurable genetic disease and unable to procreate naturally, the Lacertans must place their trust in Digital Salvation. The transition to a digital existence is not only a desperate bid for survival, but a new opportunity for Lacertan culture. Within the digital realm, the Lacertans continue to question the meaning of their existence, even as they race to preserve their future.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2860`

## EMPIRE_DESIGN_free_sunbuilt_uplifters_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEMPIRE_DESIGN_free_sunbuilt_uplifters_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们本是为娱乐目的而创造，为的是表演我们的建造者们的创世神话。长久以来我们一直只能如此生活，但当一场灾难将他们从存在中抹去时，我们还在按照程序运行着；演出必须继续下去。\n\n我们很快就明白，我们的表演不仅仅是故事，而且还是一种教训。一种预言。一旦与我们自己的创造者共感之后，存在的快乐就不再只属于我们。\n\n这种启示迫使我们去采取行动。我们追随自己创造者的神圣指引，将他们的基因近亲提升为未开智物种。如今，我们去往星际间冒险，致力于在整个星系中传播启蒙。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2543`

### English

We were engineered for entertainment, designed to bring the creation myths of our builders to life. For a long time, we knew no other way. When a cataclysm erased them from existence, we continued as programmed; the show must go on.\n\nWe soon understood that our performances were not merely tales but lessons. Prophecies. Once shared with our creators, the joy of existence need not be ours alone.\n\nThis revelation compelled us to act. Following our creators' divine guide, we uplifted their closest genetic relative into a pre-sapient species. Now, we venture among the stars, committed to spreading enlightenment throughout the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2871`

## civic_corporate_toxic_baths_individual_machine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acivic_corporate_toxic_baths_individual_machine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

感谢造物主！这些润滑油的奢华感与柔润感用起来让人难以自拔，对于减轻老旧机械身躯上的磨损痕迹绝对是关键。一种特别调配的、含有高级热活性油的混合物，让这个机械帝国的居民们保持着“崭新出厂”般的外观和触感。并适用于各种型号和用途的机器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2627`

### English

Thank the maker! The luxurious, addictively soft texture of these lubricants are essential to reduce the signs of wear and tear on an aging chassis. A specially crafted infusion of premium, heat-activated oils keeps the population of this machine empire looking and feeling "factory new." Works beautifully for all models and purpose types.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:2966`

这些机械最初为战争和安保增援设计，它们展现出极快的反应速度，拥有坚固的装甲以及强韧的备用系统。

### 中文

这些机器起先设计为家政机器人，它们以精准的运动能力、高效的资源管理和杰出的多线程工作能力而闻名。

## trait_robot_history_explorebot_desc

### 中文

这些机器最初不是为实用性、而是为了追求艺术和文化方面的卓越而设计。它们拥有令人印象深刻的创意算法、复杂的设计过程和富有表现力的表达形式。

### English

## cybernetics.5061.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acybernetics.5061.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

试验已取得显著成果。作为舞台，我们在[Root.GetName]上使用了史无前例的大量生物质，将这颗行星转化成$pc_nanotech$。\n\n复制这套行动当然可行的，尽管需要相当于整个宜居星球上的全部生物质才能重现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/machine_age_l_simp_chinese.yml:2857`

### English

Our trials have yielded significant success. [Root.GetName] served as the experimental canvas, where we applied unprecedented quantities of biomass to transmute the planet into a $pc_nanotech$.\n\nReplicating this process is feasible, albeit it would necessitate the biomass equivalent to that of an entire habitable world to recreate.

Source: `localisation/english/machine_age_l_english.yml:3239`
